items.description: 30尺。区域内遍布从漂流域撕扯而来的混乱地形。该区域为零重力。生物进入弥漫或在其中开始自己的回合时，受到@Damage[4d6[void]]伤害，并进行@Check[fortitude|dc:22|basic]豁免。

items.description: 在漂流域被复合体杀死的活体类人生物，会在[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}后作为漂流尸复起，受杀死它的漂流尸复合体控制。

items.name: 护盾术
items.description:
你举起一面由力场构成的魔法盾牌。这视为使用举盾动作，给予你AC的+1环境加值，直到你的下一回合开始，但不需要用手。

在法术生效期间，你可以用魔法盾牌使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{盾牌格挡}反应。盾牌具有硬度5。你能使用该法术的反应减少任何法术或魔法效果造成的伤害，即使其并非物理伤害。使用盾牌格挡后，法术结束，且你在10分钟内无法再次施放该法术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（+2）盾牌的硬度增加5。
items.expectedDescription:
You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

items.name: 万古步枪
items.description:
强化： 0

这把流线型激光步枪是阿兹兰特星际帝国（Azlanti Star Empire）的常备武器，内置一个插槽，供嵌入 万古石 ，以增强并聚焦光束的强度。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 0

A mainstay of the Azlanti Star Empire, this sleek laser rifle includes a slot for aeon stones to enhance and focus the intensity of its beams.

items.name: 赋生万古石
items.description:
这些宝石是阿兹兰特星际帝国（Azlanti Star Empire）的常见物品，也是冒险者和富裕收藏家青睐的身份象征。尽管外形和功能多种多样，据说这些石头全都是异界存在在远古时代建造物质宇宙（Universe）时使用的水晶工具的碎片。

当你绑定其中一颗精确切割的水晶时，石头不会戴在身上，而会环绕头部运转（若你没有头部，则环绕身体另一处可见部位）。你可以收起一颗 万古石 ，使用一个交互动作；正在环绕的石头也能被从空中夺走，只需成功进行一次 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械} 动作，以你为目标。收起或取下的石头仍保持绑定，但其效果 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] ，直到你让它再次环绕头部。

有多种类型的 万古石，每种都有不同外观和魔法效果。每个 万古石 插入特定物品后还会获得共鸣能力，例如具有万古特征的武器，或名为以下名称的古老魔法装置： 寻路石.

这个带有珍珠光泽、末端渐细的圆筒，会在你最需要时提供一口空气。你的屏息时间延长为两倍，且在对抗吸入型毒素的豁免上获得+1物品加值。其共鸣之力让你能够施放 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.ShwUELLERVMtdjwE] ，作为每天一次的神术天生法术。
items.expectedDescription:
Staple items within the Azlanti Star Empire, these gemstones are popular status symbols for adventurers and wealthy collectors. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to build the Universe in ancient times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head (or another visible part of your anatomy if you don't have a head) instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into specific items, such as weapons with the aeon trait or antique magical devices called wayfinders.

This nacreous, tapered cylinder provides a breath of air when you need it most. You can hold your breath for twice as long, and you gain a +1 item bonus to saves against inhaled poisons. The resonant power allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.ShwUELLERVMtdjwE] as a divine innate spell once per day.

items.name: 战术型七芒星卫队护甲
items.description:
强化： 0

这些装饰华丽的中甲配有夸张的护肩、风格化的龙翼，以及胸甲前后两面上的龙形徽记。天火护甲通常镀有黄金或其他悦目金属，为了造型而牺牲了强化空间。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 0

These decorative suits of medium armor feature exaggerated shoulder guards, stylized dragon wings, and draconic emblems across the breastplate's back and chest. Skyfire armor is often plated with gold or other attractive metals, sacrificing upgrade space for style.

extraFields.expected: This visor wraps around your visual organs, enhancing your natural senses. You gain darkvision.
extraFields.text: 此面罩覆盖你的视觉器官，强化你的天生感官。你获得黑暗视觉。

items.name: 万古脉冲
items.description:
七芒星勘察员释放一道魔法科技脉冲，干扰附近的科技物品。@Template[type:emanation|distance:20]内的所有生物都必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:24]豁免。七芒星勘察员在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Aeon Pulse]]{1d4轮}内不能再次使用万古脉冲。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功具有科技特征的生物和物品@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障1}。

失败具有科技特征的生物和物品@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障3}。

大失败如同失败，但具有科技特征的生物还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}。
items.expectedDescription:
The Sihedron surveyor releases a magitech pulse that disrupts nearby tech. All creatures within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:24] save. The Sihedron surveyor can't use Aeon Pulse again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Aeon Pulse]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success Creatures and items with the tech trait are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{glitching 1}.

Failure Creatures and items with the tech trait are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{glitching 3}.

Critical Failure As failure, but creatures with the tech trait are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1}.

items.name: 万古装填
items.description: 七芒星勘察员的魔法科技外皮层用一个自由动作，为其万古步枪装填。
items.expectedDescription: The Sihedron surveyor's magitech exocortex reloads their aeon rifle as a free action.

items.name: 信念崩塌
items.description:
你攻击目标的信仰，使其充满疑虑与心灵动荡，造成6d6心灵伤害；如果目标能施放神术法术，则造成6d8心灵伤害。具体效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

对于许多神祇，在没有重大缘由的情况下，对自己所信神祇的信徒施放该法术是一项禁忌。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标受到一半伤害。

失败目标受到全额伤害；如果能施放神术法术，它还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}1轮。

大失败目标受到双倍伤害，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}1轮，并在1轮内不能施放神术法术。

升阶（+1）伤害增加2d6；如果目标是神术施法者，则增加2d8。
items.expectedDescription:
You assault the target's faith, riddling the creature with doubt and mental turmoil that deal 6d6 mental damage, or 6d8 mental damage if it can cast divine spells. The effects are determined by its Will save.

To many deities, casting this spell on a follower of your own deity without significant cause is anathema.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage; if the target can cast divine spells, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round, and can't cast divine spells for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6 (or by 2d8 if the target is a divine spellcaster).

items.name: 闪电枷锁
items.expectedDescription:
You supercharge the targets' electromagnetism and pull them with a tether of lightning. Make a ranged spell attack against each target. If you attack two targets, both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but it doesn't increase until after both attacks. The targets each take 4d8 electricity damage and are pulled 5 feet closer to you, or 10 feet closer on a critical hit. If both attacks hit, you can choose to move the creatures closer to one another instead of closer to you. Moving a target into a barrier, creature, or obstacle causes the target to stop before entering that space.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你使目标的电磁场过载，并以闪电锁链将其拽向自己。对每个目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若攻击两个目标，两次攻击均计入多重攻击减值，但该减值仅在两次攻击完成后生效。每个目标受到4d8电击伤害并且向着你的方向被拉拽5尺（大成功10尺）。如果两次攻击都命中，你可以选择让两个生物彼此靠近而不是被拉向你。如果目标在位移过程中碰到街垒、生物或障碍，目标会在进入那个方格之前停下。

升阶（+1）该伤害增加1d8。

items.name: 血族盛宴
items.description:
你的触碰抽取目标的生命之血，强化自身。你对目标造成6d6虚能伤害，并获得等于目标实际受到的虚能伤害一半的临时生命值，先计入抗力等效果。1分钟后，你失去所有剩余的临时生命值。

升阶（+1）伤害增加2d6。
items.expectedDescription:
Your touch leeches the lifeblood out of a target to empower yourself. You deal 6d6 void damage to the target. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the void damage the target takes (after applying resistances and the like). You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

items.name: 卜筮术
items.description:
你模糊地窥见未来。施放该法术时，询问采取某种特定行动的结果。法术可以预测未来至多30分钟内的结果，并以以下结果呈现GM的最佳判断：吉、凶、吉凶参半（结果有好有坏）或平（没有特别好或特别坏的结果）。

GM秘密进行一次@Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]。失败时，结果总是“平”，使人无法判断“平”是否准确。如果有人在后续施放中询问与首次施放卜筮术相同的主题，GM会使用首次施放时的秘密掷骰结果。不过，如果情况发生变化，也可能得到不同的结果。
items.expectedDescription:
You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveal the GM's best guess among the following outcomes: good, bad, mixed (the results will be a mix of good and bad), and nothing (there won't be particularly good or bad results).

The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.

items.name: 解除魔法
items.description: 你瓦解法术或效果背后的魔法。对目标尝试反制检定。如果成功反制一件魔法物品，该物品会变为同类型的普通物品，持续10分钟。这不会改变物品的非魔法属性。如果目标是神器或类似物品，你自动失败。
items.expectedDescription: You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

items.name: 末日刷屏
items.expectedDescription:
You magically broadcast grim news onto nearby devices, holo projectors, screens, and other displays (including comm units on armor). Creatures in the area who can see one or more displays must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the display.

Failure The creature is fascinated by the display and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (even if the fascination ends).

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated by the display, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} (even if the fascination ends).
items.description:
你可以用魔法在附近的设备、全息投影仪、屏幕和其他显示器（包括护甲上的通讯单元）上播报可怕的消息。区域内能看到一个或多个显示屏的生物必须尝试意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物因显示内容@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]。

失败该生物被显示内容迷魂，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}状态（即使迷魂结束也是如此）。

大失败该生物被显示内容迷魂，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧3}状态，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭1}状态（即使迷魂结束也是如此）。

items.name: 灵魂激涌
items.expectedDescription:
You channel your life force into a spear of energy. You lose 6 Hit Points or, if you're in a bond with a vitality network that has at least 12 Hit Points, you can reduce the vitality bond's Hit Points by 12 instead. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d6 spirit damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2 (or by 4 if you spend Hit Points from a vitality network).
items.description:
你将生命力凝聚成一支能量长矛。你失去6点生命值；如果你处于一个具有至少12点生命值的命能网络纽带中，可以改为使该命能纽带失去12点生命值。进行一次远程法术攻击，对抗目标的AC。命中时，你造成6d6精魂伤害。重击时，目标受到双倍伤害，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失1}。

升阶（+1）造成的伤害增加2d6，失去的生命值增加2；如果花费命能网络的生命值，则增加4。

items.name: 诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你从群星之间的黑暗虚空中凝聚一束侵袭心灵的诡异能量，射向目标。对抗目标的AC进行远程法术攻击检定。命中时，你造成2d6心灵伤害。大成功时，你造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 衰弱术
items.description:
你抽走目标的力量，具体效果取决于其强韧豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭1}，直到你的下一回合开始。

失败目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭2}，持续1分钟。

items.name: 信用棒
items.description:
《Starfinder》中的大多数人将财富储存在一种称为信用棒的受保护物品中。这些设备通常扁平，约有人类手指大小。虽然尺寸和品质各异，但归根结底，它们只是方便携带和花费金钱的工具。设备的使用方式由主人决定；信用棒只需在合适的银行设备附近轻触一下，便能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求声纹或生物特征印记才能启动。一些先进信用棒甚至包含魔法组件，可能需要心灵密码或念诵特定法术，才能取用储存的资金。

信用棒并不连通一个人的全部财富，大量信用点通常安全地存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒则是安全、匿名、不会留下追踪线索的信用点转移方式。冒险者和普通市民都常随身携带信用棒，应付可能的购物需求，同时只在其中保留适量信用点，确保丢失信用棒也不至于破产。

协约世界的居民经常携带信用棒，与协约世界往来的其他文明也常将本地资金兑换为信用点，携带信用棒花费兑换后的货币。有些人可能带着数根信用棒，将每根用于不同用途，或在购买固定金额的商品时直接将信用棒交易出去。如果随身的信用棒数量过多，将资金在不同棒之间转移，并丢弃空棒以节省空间也十分容易；不过，单根信用棒的负载始终可忽略不计。
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.

items.name: 公司承诺
items.description: 纳佐尔用误导性的奉承和不诚实的措辞，许诺晋升、更好的食物或中途站上更好的生活，哄骗员工听命行事。15尺内的一名员工用一个反应快步、行走、打击或擒拿。

You delete up to 1,500 words' worth of text, one page of content, or one display screen worth of text or other visual information. Non-magical writing in or on an unattended or held object is automatically deleted. Attempt a counteract check to delete digital or magical writing. If you fail to delete writing that's part of a hazard, you trigger the hazard. This can't be used to delete the contents of a spellbook or similar means of storing magical formulas or spells.

If you target an attended tech item with the tracking trait, attempt a counteract check. On a success, the item becomes glitching 1. A creature holding the item can Interact to restart the software, reducing the glitching value by 1.

Heightened (7th) You can delete all the data stored locally on a single device or book, or all the data on a device or book related to a specific name, topic, or category.

成功目标听到了诡异的低语，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}，持续1轮。

失败目标开始漫无目的地游荡，使用每个动作来快步（方向随机）。当其移动时，其会采取最安全的路线并且不会进入有害地形。法术会持续1分钟或者直到目标被敌对动作瞄准。

大失败类似失败，除了目标还会语无伦次地喋喋不休。任何在其20尺内开始回合的生物也需要尝试一次意志豁免。在失败时，这些生物也需要在下回合开始时花费第一个动作来进行快步（随机方向），随后临时免疫此法术24小时。这是一个失能效果。

items.name: 末日刷屏
items.expectedDescription:
You magically broadcast grim news onto nearby devices, holo projectors, screens, and other displays (including comm units on armor). Creatures in the area who can see one or more displays must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the display.

Failure The creature is fascinated by the display and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (even if the fascination ends).

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated by the display, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} (even if the fascination ends).
items.description:
你可以用魔法在附近的设备、全息投影仪、屏幕和其他显示器（包括护甲上的通讯单元）上播报可怕的消息。区域内能看到一个或多个显示屏的生物必须尝试意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物因显示内容@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]。

失败该生物被显示内容迷魂，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}状态（即使迷魂结束也是如此）。

大失败该生物被显示内容迷魂，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧3}状态，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭1}状态（即使迷魂结束也是如此）。

items.name: 狂乱偏执
items.description:
你使目标将其他所有生物视为严重威胁。目标对周围所有生物产生强烈的偏执恐惧，必须尝试意志豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标相信眼前每个人都是潜在威胁。它对原本尚未敌对的所有生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{不友善}，即使曾经是盟友也不例外。它不将任何人视为盟友。法术在1轮后结束。

失败如同成功，但效果持续1分钟。

大失败如同失败，但目标相信眼前每个人都是死敌。它会对所有人使用反应和自由动作，无论先前是否为盟友，具体由GM决定。除此之外，它会像平时一样理性行动，比起不理会自己的生物，更可能优先攻击正在攻击或妨碍自己的生物。

升阶（6环）你能以至多5个生物为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You cause the target to see all other creatures as dire threats. The target is stricken by intense paranoia toward all creatures around it and must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target believes everyone it sees is a potential threat. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.I1ffBVISxLr2gC4u]{Unfriendly} to all creatures to which it wasn't already hostile, even those that were previously allies. It treats no one as an ally. The spell ends after 1 round.

Failure As success, but the effect lasts 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target believes that everyone it sees is a mortal enemy. It uses its reactions and free actions against everyone, regardless of whether they were previously its allies, as determined by the GM. It otherwise acts as rationally as it normally does and likely prefers to attack creatures that are actively attacking or hindering it over those leaving it alone.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 5 creatures.

items.name: 情绪控制
items.description:
你以心灵力量向一个生物的心智投射强烈情绪，与其分享心情。目标尝试意志豁免。失败时，它体验到你从以下情绪中选择的一种；如果选择愤怒或喜悦，该法术获得失能特征。

  • 愤怒目标在其下一回合必须用第一个动作攻击最近的生物，即使那是盟友。
  • 喜悦目标不能采取任何敌对行为。
  • 恐惧目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}。
  • 悲伤目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}并放声哭泣。

升阶（4环）该法术影响20尺爆发内的所有生物。每个生物都必须受到同一种情绪影响。
items.expectedDescription:
You share a mood by psychically projecting an intense emotion into a creature's mind. The target attempts a Will save. On a failure, the target experiences your choice of the following emotions, but if you pick anger or joy this spell gains the incapacitation trait.

  • Anger On its next turn, the target spends its first action to attack the nearest creature, even if it's an ally.
  • Joy The target can't take any hostile actions.
  • Fear The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.
  • Sorrow The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and bursts into tears.

Heightened (4th) The spell affects all creatures in a 20-foot burst. Each creature must be affected by the same emotion.

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 绝望术
items.description:
你使敌人的心智充满疑虑。区域内的敌人必须通过意志豁免，否则只要仍在区域内，其攻击检定就受到–1状态减值。在后续的回合中，你可以每轮一次维持该法术，使弥漫半径增加10尺，并迫使区域内尚未受到影响的敌人再次尝试豁免。

绝望术可以反制@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{祝福术}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{法术效果：绝望术}
items.expectedDescription:
You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt. Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a –1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw.

Bane can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}

items.name: 诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你从群星之间的黑暗虚空中凝聚一束侵袭心灵的诡异能量，射向目标。对抗目标的AC进行远程法术攻击检定。命中时，你造成2d6心灵伤害。大成功时，你造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 衰弱术
items.description:
你抽走目标的力量，具体效果取决于其强韧豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭1}，直到你的下一回合开始。

失败目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭2}，持续1分钟。

大失败目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭3}，持续1分钟。
items.expectedDescription:
You sap the target's strength, depending on its Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} for 1 minute.

items.name: 邪影触须
items.description:
黑暗卷须从你的指尖蜷曲而出，疾掠过空中。你对线形区域内的活物造成2d4虚能伤害和@Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]]伤害。线形区域内每个活物都必须尝试强韧豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半虚能伤害，并且不受持续流血伤害。

失败该生物受到完整伤害。

大失败 该生物承受双倍虚能伤害和双倍持续流血伤害。

升阶（+1） 该虚能伤害增加2d4，持续流血伤害增加1。
items.expectedDescription:
Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

items.name: 心灵穿刺
items.expectedDescription:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你以大量心灵信息或神祇裁决使一个生物的心智超载。心灵冲击造成2d6心灵伤害。大失败时，目标还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}状态，持续1轮。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加 2d6。

items.name: 黑暗术
items.description:
你创造一层黑暗帷幕，使光线无法穿透，也无法在区域内发出。光线不能进入该区域，且区域内任何非魔法光源，例如火把或提灯，都不会发光，即使其光照半径本能延伸至黑暗区域之外也是如此。这也会压制与你的黑暗术环阶相等或更低的魔法光亮。光线无法通过，因此区域内的生物无法看见外面。从外部看，这是一颗纯粹黑暗的球体。

升阶（4环）即使具有黑暗视觉（但不是高等黑暗视觉）的生物，也只能勉强看穿这片黑暗。它们将透过黑暗看见的目标视为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。
items.expectedDescription:
You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

Force fields absorb damage. A force field's Hit Points are based on its version. While your force field is active, any physical or energy damage you would take is applied to the force field's Hit Points first before being applied to your Hit Points (including temporary Hit Points). If your force field is tactical or better, it also protects you from deadly blows. Each time you're critically hit while your force field is active, attempt a flat check against the listed DC. On a success, it becomes a normal hit.

items.description:

items.name: 腐朽激爆
items.expectedDescription:
A giant pustule swells and explodes, coating everything around it in life-draining rot. Creatures and plants in the area take 6d6 poison damage and must attempt a Reflex save. Foliage and plant matter in the area damaged by the spell no longer provide cover.

items.description:

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.description:
你发出一道感应魔法存在的脉冲。除魔法是否存在外，你不会获得其他信息。你可以选择忽略自己完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品和持续中的法术。只有幻术魔法效应的环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到它。不过，具有幻术灵光、但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如隐形药水），通常仍能正常侦测。

升阶（3环）你得知此法术侦测到的最强魔法效应的环阶或等级，由GM决定。

升阶（4环）如同3环，但你还能定位最高环阶魔法的来源。如同不精确感官，你不会得知确切位置，但能将来源缩小至一个5尺立方空间内（若来源更大，则为最近的该大小空间）。
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

你举起一面由力场构成的魔法盾牌。这视为使用举盾动作，给予你AC的+1环境加值，直到你的下一回合开始，但不需要用手。

items.name: 集成赋生万古石
items.description:
这些宝石是阿兹兰特星际帝国（Azlanti Star Empire）的常见物品，也是冒险者和富裕收藏家青睐的身份象征。尽管外形和功能多种多样，据说这些石头全都是异界存在在远古时代建造物质宇宙（Universe）时使用的水晶工具的碎片。

当你绑定其中一颗精确切割的水晶时，石头不会戴在身上，而会环绕头部运转（若你没有头部，则环绕身体另一处可见部位）。你可以收起一颗 万古石 ，使用一个交互动作；正在环绕的石头也能被从空中夺走，只需成功进行一次 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械} 动作，以你为目标。收起或取下的石头仍保持绑定，但其效果 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] ，直到你让它再次环绕头部。

有多种类型的 万古石，每种都有不同外观和魔法效果。每个 万古石 插入特定物品后还会获得共鸣能力，例如具有万古特征的武器，或名为以下名称的古老魔法装置： 寻路石.

这个带有珍珠光泽、末端渐细的圆筒，会在你最需要时提供一口空气。你的屏息时间延长为两倍，且在对抗吸入型毒素的豁免上获得+1物品加值。其共鸣之力让你能够施放 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.ShwUELLERVMtdjwE] ，作为每天一次的神术天生法术。
items.expectedDescription:
Staple items within the Azlanti Star Empire, these gemstones are popular status symbols for adventurers and wealthy collectors. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to build the Universe in ancient times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head (or another visible part of your anatomy if you don't have a head) instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into specific items, such as weapons with the aeon trait or antique magical devices called wayfinders.

This nacreous, tapered cylinder provides a breath of air when you need it most. You can hold your breath for twice as long, and you gain a +1 item bonus to saves against inhaled poisons. The resonant power allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.ShwUELLERVMtdjwE] as a divine innate spell once per day.

items.name: +1武器威能水晶（恒星耀斑）
items.description: 此物品将模拟恒星活动所需的专注凝为晶体。恒星武器或恒星耀斑的攻击检定获得+1物品加值，且该武器或耀斑可以从一颗轨道水晶中受益。

items.expectedDescription: This gem contains the condensed matter of a star and increases the weapon damage dice of a solar weapon or flare to two instead of one.

items.name: 调整形态
items.description: 金色科希科重新排列骨骼，适应当前处境，选择矮壮、瘦长或柔韧形态之一。选择矮壮形态时，其用于[[/act force-open]]的运动检定获得+2环境加值；选择瘦长形态时，其用于[[/act squeeze]]的特技检定获得+2环境加值；选择柔韧形态时，其持用近战武器的触及范围增至10尺。
items.expectedDescription: The golden coshyco rearranges their skeleton to adapt to their circumstances. They choose between squat, lanky, or flexible. If they take on the squat shape, they gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to [[/act force-open]]. If they choose lanky, they gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to [[/act squeeze]]. If they choose flexible, their reach increases to 10 feet with held melee weapons.

items.name: 偷袭
items.description: 金色科希科的打击对@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}的生物额外造成1d6精准伤害。
items.expectedDescription: The Golden coshyco's Strikes deal 1d6 extra precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

items.name: 分担痛苦
items.expectedDescription:
You telepathically share the sensation of agonizing pain with a creature. The target takes 3d12 mental damage and attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) The spell targets up to four creatures and deals 6d12 mental damage.
items.description:
你以心灵感应的方式与一个生物分享痛苦的感觉。目标受到3d12精神伤害，并尝试意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害。

失败该生物受到全额伤害，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，持续1分钟。

大失败该生物受到全额伤害，并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环）该法术最多可瞄准四个生物，并造成6d12心灵伤害。

items.name: 卜筮术
items.description:
你模糊地窥见未来。施放该法术时，询问采取某种特定行动的结果。法术可以预测未来至多30分钟内的结果，并以以下结果呈现GM的最佳判断：吉、凶、吉凶参半（结果有好有坏）或平（没有特别好或特别坏的结果）。

GM秘密进行一次@Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]。失败时，结果总是“平”，使人无法判断“平”是否准确。如果有人在后续施放中询问与首次施放卜筮术相同的主题，GM会使用首次施放时的秘密掷骰结果。不过，如果情况发生变化，也可能得到不同的结果。
items.expectedDescription:
You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveal the GM's best guess among the following outcomes: good, bad, mixed (the results will be a mix of good and bad), and nothing (there won't be particularly good or bad results).

The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.

items.name: 解除魔法
items.description: 你瓦解法术或效果背后的魔法。对目标尝试反制检定。如果成功反制一件魔法物品，该物品会变为同类型的普通物品，持续10分钟。这不会改变物品的非魔法属性。如果目标是神器或类似物品，你自动失败。
items.expectedDescription: You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

items.name: 末日刷屏
items.expectedDescription:
You magically broadcast grim news onto nearby devices, holo projectors, screens, and other displays (including comm units on armor). Creatures in the area who can see one or more displays must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the display.

Failure The creature is fascinated by the display and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (even if the fascination ends).

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated by the display, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} (even if the fascination ends).
items.description:
你可以用魔法在附近的设备、全息投影仪、屏幕和其他显示器（包括护甲上的通讯单元）上播报可怕的消息。区域内能看到一个或多个显示屏的生物必须尝试意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物因显示内容@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]。

失败该生物被显示内容迷魂，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}状态（即使迷魂结束也是如此）。

大失败该生物被显示内容迷魂，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧3}状态，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭1}状态（即使迷魂结束也是如此）。

items.name: 灵魂激涌
items.expectedDescription:
You channel your life force into a spear of energy. You lose 6 Hit Points or, if you're in a bond with a vitality network that has at least 12 Hit Points, you can reduce the vitality bond's Hit Points by 12 instead. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d6 spirit damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2 (or by 4 if you spend Hit Points from a vitality network).
items.description:
你将生命力凝聚成一支能量长矛。你失去6点生命值；如果你处于一个具有至少12点生命值的命能网络纽带中，可以改为使该命能纽带失去12点生命值。进行一次远程法术攻击，对抗目标的AC。命中时，你造成6d6精魂伤害。重击时，目标受到双倍伤害，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失1}。

升阶（+1）造成的伤害增加2d6，失去的生命值增加2；如果花费命能网络的生命值，则增加4。

items.name: 祝福术
items.description:
来自彼方的祝福帮助同伴准确攻击。你和盟友在弥漫内时，攻击检定获得+1状态加值。在后续回合，你可以每轮一次维持该法术，使弥漫半径增加10尺。

祝福术可以反制@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7ZinJNzxq0XF0oMx]{绝望术}。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Gqy7K6FnbLtwGpud]{法术效果：祝福术}
items.expectedDescription:
Blessings from beyond help your companions strike true. You and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls while within the emanation. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet.

Bless can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7ZinJNzxq0XF0oMx]{Bane}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Gqy7K6FnbLtwGpud]{Spell Effect: Bless}

items.name: 命令术
items.description:
你高声发出一道难以忽视的命令。你可以命令目标接近你、逃跑（如同处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}状态）、放开所持物品、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，或站在原地。在服从你的命令之前，它不能@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{延迟}，也不能使用任何反应。具体效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

成功该生物不受影响。

失败该生物必须在其下一回合，以第一个动作花费一个单动作服从你的命令。

大失败目标必须用其下一回合的全部动作服从你的命令。

升阶（5环）你能以至多10个生物为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

items.name: 衰弱术
items.description:
你抽走目标的力量，具体效果取决于其强韧豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭1}，直到你的下一回合开始。

失败目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭2}，持续1分钟。

大失败目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭3}，持续1分钟。
items.expectedDescription:
You sap the target's strength, depending on its Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} for 1 minute.

items.name: 伤害术
items.description:
你引导虚能，伤害活物或治疗不死生物。如果目标是活物，你对其造成1d8虚能伤害，目标进行基础强韧豁免。如果目标是自愿的不死生物，你为其恢复等量的生命值。施放该法术时花费的动作数量决定目标、射程、区域和其他参数。

1该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个不死生物，回复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放虚能。这会以区域中所有活物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1）治疗量或伤害增加1d8，且两动作版本的额外治疗量增加8。
items.expectedDescription:
You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse void energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

items.name: 心灵穿刺
items.expectedDescription:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你以大量心灵信息或神祇裁决使一个生物的心智超载。心灵冲击造成2d6心灵伤害。大失败时，目标还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}状态，持续1轮。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加 2d6。

items.name: 转移命能
items.description: 璃殇祭司将命能网络中任意数量的生命值转移给一个其能看见且结成纽带的目标。
items.expectedDescription: The priest of Lissala transfers any number of Hit Points from its vitality network to a visible bonded target.

items.name: 恐惧术
items.description:
你将恐惧植入目标；它必须进行意志豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}状态。

失败目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}状态。

大失败目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧3}状态，并处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}状态1轮。

升阶（3环）你能以至多五个生物为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

items.name: 命能网络（专长）
items.description: 璃殇祭司拥有一个命能网络，能如同秘术师一般，将命能引导给至多4名结成纽带的盟友。网络最多储存@Damage[20[healing]]生命值，并在战斗开始时蓄满。
items.expectedDescription: A priest of Lissala has a network of vitality they can channel up to 4 bonded allies as though they were a mystic. This network can store a maximum of @Damage[20[healing]] Hit Points and is full at the start of combat.

items.name: 充盈命能
items.description:
频率每轮一次

效果璃殇祭司为命能网络恢复6点生命值，最多达到其上限。
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency one per round

Effect The priest of Lissala restores 6 Hit Pints to their vitality network, up to its maximum.

nID7bQHIDxI9HSQu.name: 璃殇祭司 Priest of Lissala

items.name: 石墙术
items.description:
你塑造一堵坚实石墙，厚1英寸、长至多120尺、高20尺。你可以塑造墙体的路径，将每5尺墙体放在方格之间的边界上。墙体无需竖直，因此可以形成桥梁或阶梯等结构。你必须在连续的开放空间内创造墙体，使其边界不穿过任何生物或物体，否则便会失去该法术。

每段10尺见方的墙体具有AC 10、硬度14和50点生命值，免疫重击和精准伤害。被摧毁的部分可以穿过，但留下的碎石是困难地形。

升阶（+2）每段墙体的生命值增加15。
items.expectedDescription:
You shape a wall of solid stone. You create a 1-inch-thick wall of stone up to 120 feet long, and 20 feet high. You can shape the wall's path, placing each 5 feet of the wall on the border between squares. The wall doesn't need to stand vertically, so you can use it to form a bridge or set of stairs, for example. You must conjure the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost.

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 14, and 50 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. A destroyed section of the wall can be moved through, but the rubble created from it is difficult terrain.

Heightened (+2) The Hit Points of each section of the wall increase by 15.

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.description:
你发出一道感应魔法存在的脉冲。除魔法是否存在外，你不会获得其他信息。你可以选择忽略自己完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品和持续中的法术。只有幻术魔法效应的环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到它。不过，具有幻术灵光、但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如隐形药水），通常仍能正常侦测。

升阶（3环）你得知此法术侦测到的最强魔法效应的环阶或等级，由GM决定。

升阶（4环）如同3环，但你还能定位最高环阶魔法的来源。如同不精确感官，你不会得知确切位置，但能将来源缩小至一个5尺立方空间内（若来源更大，则为最近的该大小空间）。
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

items.name: 隐匿士兵护甲
items.description:
强化： 1

这套重甲的头盔只有一道狭缝，仅露出穿戴者的眼睛。这套高科技陶瓷护甲由胸甲、肩甲、护臂和胫甲组成，会随身体动作灵活活动。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This suit of heavy armor features a slitted helmet that reveals only the wearer's eyes. This high-tech ceramic suit consists of breastplate, shoulder guards, bracers, and greaves that flex with the body's movements.

items.expectedName: Interplanar Teleport (to Astral Plane, Elemental Planes, or the Universe only)
items.name: 跨界传送（仅限星界、元素位面或宇宙）
items.description:
需求你持有目的地位面的位面密钥，用作施法载体

你和盟友穿越位面间的屏障。目标移动到另一个位面，例如火元素位面、影界或外层裂隙。你必须知晓目的地位面的存在，并使用以该位面物质制作的魔法位面密钥作为此法术的施法载体。大多数著名位面的位面密钥与跨界传送法术本身一样罕见，而鲜为人知的位面和半位面的位面密钥通常稀有，甚至可能独特。

该法术十分不精确。选择一个目标，你会出现在距离该目标上一次前往此位面时最终所在位置1d20×25英里的地方。如果所有目标都是首次前往该位面，你会出现在该位面的随机位置。跨界传送不提供返程手段，但除非存在特殊情况，否则再次施放跨界传送就能让你返回先前的位面。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You have a planar key for the destination plane, used as a locus

You and your allies traverse the barriers between planes of existence. The targets move to another plane, such as the Plane of Fire, the Netherworld, or the Outer Rifts. You must know the destination plane exists and use a magic planar key created from material from that plane as a locus for the spell. While the planar keys for most prominent planes are uncommon, just like the spell interplanar teleport, more obscure planes and demiplanes often have rare or possibly even unique planar keys.

The spell is highly imprecise, and you appear 1d20×25 miles from the last place one of the targets (of your choice) was located the last time that target traveled to the plane. If it's the first time traveling to a particular plane for all targets, you appear at a random location on the plane. Interplanar teleport doesn't provide a means of return travel, though casting interplanar teleport again allows you to return to your previous plane unless there are extenuating circumstances.

items.name: 实言术（恒定）
items.description:
目标能理解所有语言的言辞，也能说其他生物的语言。身处一群使用不同语言的生物中时，目标每次说话都可以选择一个生物，使用该生物理解的语言讲话，即使目标不知道那是什么语言。

升阶（7环）持续时间为8小时。
items.expectedDescription:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

items.name: 塑石术（随意）
items.description:
你将石头塑成所选的粗略形状。这种塑形过于粗糙，无法制造复杂部件、精细细节、可动组件等结构。重塑时，站在石头上的每个生物都必须尝试反射豁免或特技检定。

成功该生物不受影响。

items.expectedDescription: 15 feet. A mosaic soul glows with a colored light, casting dim light in the emanation.

items.name: 紊乱情绪
items.description: 镶嵌魂灵对抗情绪效果的豁免失败时，形体会完全化为一种纯色，并在[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}内失去虚体特征。在此期间，镶嵌魂灵无法使用旋舞色彩，且其奇异光芒灵光停用。
items.expectedDescription: When a mosaic soul fails a saving throw against an emotion effect, a single solid hue takes over its form, and it loses the incorporeal trait for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}. During this time, the mosaic soul can't use Swirling Colors, and its strange light aura is disabled.

items.name: 镶嵌之触
items.description: 魂灵的触碰打击将活物拆解为基本组成，留下类似强酸灼伤的重创。因镶嵌魂灵的触碰打击损失生命值的活物必须通过@Check[fortitude|dc:17]豁免，否则受到@Damage[2d6[persistent,acid]]伤害。
items.expectedDescription: The soul's touch Strike unravels living targets into their components, leaving grievous wounds like acid burns. A living creature that takes Hit Point damage from the mosaic soul's touch Strike and must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:17] save or take @Damage[2d6[persistent,acid]] damage.

items.name: 旋舞色彩
items.description:
镶嵌魂灵的颜色在可怕的闪光中闪烁反转。@Template[type:emanation|distance:30]内的所有其他生物都必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:19]豁免，镶嵌魂灵免疫此能力。它的奇异光芒灵光改为提供明亮光照，直到其下一回合开始。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}，直到其下一回合结束。

失败该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}，直到其下回合结束。

大失败该生物目盲，直到其下一回合结束，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}1分钟。
items.expectedDescription:
The mosaic soul's colors shimmer and invert in terrible flashes. All other creatures within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:19] save (mosaic souls are immune to this ability). The mosaic soul's strange light aura casts bright light until the start of its next turn.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of its next turn.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded until the end of its next turn and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} for 1 minute.

items.name: 掠飞连击
items.description: 布兰图沿直线飞行至多等于其速度的距离，并对直线上至多三个生物各进行一次翼刺打击。打击命中时，该生物受到伤害，并措手不及，直到布兰图的下一回合开始。
items.expectedDescription: The braantu flies up to its Speed in a line and makes a wing spur Strike against up to three creatures in the line. If the Strike hits, the creature takes damage and is off-guard until the beginning of the braantu's next turn.

items.description: 成年月熊对同一目标进行两次爪击打击。如果两次都命中，目标被击至@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。
items.expectedDescription: The mature moon bear makes two claw Strikes against the same target. If both Strikes hit, the target is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

items.description: 成年月熊对威胁其幼崽的任何生物额外造成4点伤害。

items.name: 废机电火花
items.description:
一波电流从废弃收割机故障的动力核心中迸发。@Template[type:cone|distance:20]内的所有生物都必须尝试@Check[reflex|dc:21]豁免。

大成功该生物不受伤害。

成功该生物受到@Damage[1d6[electricity]|options:area-damage]伤害。

失败该生物受到@Damage[2d6[electricity]|options:area-damage]伤害，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}1轮。

大失败该生物受到@Damage[4d6[electricity]|options:area-damage]伤害，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢2}1轮。
items.expectedDescription:
A wave of electricity bursts from the derelict harvester's malfunctioning power core. All creatures in a @Template[type:cone|distance:20] must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:21] save.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes @Damage[1d6[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[2d6[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[4d6[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 round.

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 测量术
items.expectedDescription:
You learn the approximate measurements (length, width, depth, height, and weight) of creatures and objects you can observe in the area. If an object or creature extends out of the area, you learn only the measurements within the area, but nothing about what you can't observe. For example, you can't determine the thickness or weight of a wall you can observe only one side of, or the depth of water that extends beyond the spell's range. Each time you Sustain the spell, you learn the exact measurements of one creature or object in the area, including imprecisions or anomalies that might indicate structural weakness. Magically altered targets give you information that reflects what you observe rather than accurate measurements.

Heightened (+1) Extend the range of measure by 100 feet.
items.description:
你可以了解周围生物和物体的大致尺寸（长度、宽度、深度、高度和重量）。如果物体或生物延伸出了该射程，你只能了解该区域内的测量值，而无法观察到的东西则无法了解。例如，你无法确定只能观察到一面的墙壁的厚度或重量，也无法确定超出法术射程的水深。每次维持法术时，你都会了解该区域内一种生物或物体的精确测量结果，包括可能揭示结构弱点的不精确或异常现象。被魔法改变的目标所提供的信息反映的是你所观察到的情况，而不是精确测量值。

升阶（+1）延展测量距离100尺。

items.name: 扫描环境
items.expectedDescription:
You analyze the natural environment in the area within 1 mile, learning general information about the atmosphere, biomes, and gravity. You forecast the weather for the next hour, including the direction it will come from; learn which atmospheres, biomes, and gravity are in the area, as well as the direction and distance to those elements; and learn if anything in the area presents an environmental hazard, including cold or heat dangers (at what temperature range), radiation (at what severity), smoke effects, and underwater conditions. This is enough to detect large effects that span spaces over 30 feet in diameter only. You gain a general sense of where and how far away these dangers are.

Heightened (+1) The scanned area increases in radius by 1 mile.
items.description:
你分析1英里范围内的自然环境，了解大气层、生物群落和重力的一般信息。预测未来一小时的天气，包括天气自哪而来；了解该区域有哪些大气、生物群落和重力，以及与这些元素的方向和距离；了解该区域是否存在环境危害，包括冷热危险（在什么温度范围）、辐射（严重程度）、烟雾效果和水下条件。这足以探测到直径超过30英尺的大型效果。你可以大致了解这些危险的位置和距离。

升阶（+1）扫描范围增加1英里。

items.name: 寻觅星辰
items.expectedDescription:
In your mind's eye, you chart a path through the cosmos. If you're in Pact Worlds space, you immediately know which direction to travel in order to reach the Starstone on Absalom Station. If you're outside the Pact System, you know the direction to the nearest Drift beacon or the Starstone.

Heightened (7th) You can instead know the direction to a familiar location, such as a world or way station you've visited.
items.description:
在你的脑海中，你绘制了一条穿越宇宙的路径。如果你在协约世界的空间中，你就能立刻知道前往星石和艾巴萨罗姆空间站的方向。如果你在协约世界以外的空间，你会知道前往最近的漂流信标或星石的方向。

升阶（7环）你可以知道前往熟悉地点的方向，例如你曾经去过的世界或中转站。

items.name: 实言术（恒定）
items.description:
目标能理解所有语言的言辞，也能说其他生物的语言。身处一群使用不同语言的生物中时，目标每次说话都可以选择一个生物，使用该生物理解的语言讲话，即使目标不知道那是什么语言。

升阶（7环）持续时间为8小时。
items.expectedDescription:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

items.name: 拯救灵魂
items.description: 赫斯特拉莫能感知一光秒内的求救信号，约186000英里。
items.expectedDescription: A hestramo can sense distress signals within one light-second (approximately 186,000 miles).

items.name: 穿船通行
items.description: 赫斯特拉莫可以穿过星舰的墙壁、天花板、地板及物体，如同具有虚体特征。
items.expectedDescription: The hestramo can move through walls, ceilings, floors, and objects in a starship as if they have the incorporeal trait.

items.name: 短波通讯
items.description: 赫斯特拉莫能与范围内具有短波能力或科技特征的任何生物进行无线通信。它们可以对范围内具有科技特征的物品尝试计算机检定来骇入，或尝试贼活检定来解除装置。
items.expectedDescription: A hestramo can communicate wirelessly with any creatures in range if they have the shortwave ability or are a creature with the tech trait. They can attempt Computers checks to Hack and Thievery checks to Disable a Device on items with the tech trait within this range.

items.name: 滑移驱动
items.description: 赫斯特拉莫体内有一台生物机械漂流引擎，能够在漂流域与其他位面之间，以及两个非漂流域位面之间自由旅行。它们可以随意将@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{跨界传送}作为7环异能内在法术施放。
items.expectedDescription: The hestramo has an internal biomechanical Drift engine that enables them to travel freely between the Drift and other planes, as well as between two non-Drift planes. They can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport} as a 7th-rank occult innate spell at will.

items.name: 反应打击
items.description:
触发你触及范围内的一个生物使用操作动作或移动动作、进行远程攻击，或在使用移动动作时离开一个方格。

你攻击露出破绽的敌人，对触发生物进行一次近战打击。如果此次攻击重击，且触发为操作动作，你打断该动作。此次打击不计入多重攻击减值，也不受多重攻击减值影响。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within your reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If your attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, you disrupt that action. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

items.name: 效果：多头蛇之头
items.description: 多头蛇当前拥有的头数。
items.expectedDescription: The number of heads the hydra currently has.

items.name: 天外金属蜕变：山铜
items.description: 布朗科仅剩两个头时，会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}，额外动作只能用于行走或打击。
items.expectedDescription: When Bronco has only two heads remaining, he is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. He can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike.

items.name: 多头蛇再生
items.description: 布朗科的再生值等于头数×3。如果多头蛇失去任何头部，且剩余断颈尚未被灼封，它在因再生恢复生命值后尝试@Check[fortitude|immutable:true|dc:29]豁免。成功时，一处未灼封的断颈长出两个头；大成功时，两处未灼封的断颈各长出两个头。多头蛇的头数永远不能超过通常头数的两倍。只有当全部头都被斩断、且所有断颈都被灼封时，再生才会完全停用，多头蛇随之死亡。
items.expectedDescription: Bronco has regeneration equal to 3 × the number of heads it has. If a hydra's body is missing any heads and the remaining stumps have not been cauterized, the hydra attempts a @Check[fortitude|immutable:true|dc:29] save after it regains Hit Points from regeneration. On a success, one uncauterized stump regrows two heads; on a critical success, two uncauterized stumps regrow into two heads each. The hydra can never grow more than double the number of heads it ordinarily has. The hydra's regeneration only fully deactivates if all its heads are severed and all stumps are cauterized, at which point it dies.

items.name: 头部重生
items.description:
布朗科有五个头。生物可以专门瞄准多头蛇的一个头，造成等于该头生命值的伤害，尝试将其斩断。未被完全斩断的头在任何生物的回合结束时都会恢复全部生命值。

布朗科可以用多头蛇再生重新长出被斩断的头。生物可以对断颈造成酸蚀或火焰伤害，将其灼封以阻止重生。单目标酸蚀或火焰效果必须指定一处断颈；如果溅射或区域效果覆盖多头蛇的整个空间并造成酸蚀或火焰伤害，就会灼封全部断颈。如果斩断头部的攻击造成任何酸蚀或火焰伤害，断颈会立即灼封。如果五个头全部被斩断并灼封，布朗科死亡。
items.expectedDescription:
Bronco has five heads. A creature can attempt to sever one of the hydra's heads by specifically targeting it and dealing damage equal to the head's Hit Points. A head that isn't completely severed returns to full Hit Points at the end of any creature's turn.

Bronco can regrow a severed head using hydra regeneration. A creature can prevent this regrowth by dealing acid or fire damage to the stump, cauterizing it. Single-target acid or fire effects need to be targeted at a specific stump, but effects that deal splash damage or affect areas covering the hydra's whole space cauterize all stumps if they deal acid or fire damage. If the attack that severs a head deals any acid or fire damage, the stump is cauterized instantly. If all five heads are severed and cauterized, Bronco dies.

items.name: 应击诸首
items.description: 除第一个头以外，布朗科每有一个头，每轮便获得一个额外反应，仅能用于应击。同一个触发动作最多只能使用1个反应，即使生物离开其触及范围内的多个方格也一样；多头蛇每次应击都必须用不同的头。每有一个头被斩断，多头蛇每轮便失去一个额外反应。
items.expectedDescription: Bronco gains an extra reaction per round for each of its heads beyond the first, which it can use only to make Reactive Strikes. It can't use more than 1 reaction on the same triggering action, even if a creature leaves several squares within its reach, and the hydra must use a different head for each Reactive Strike it makes. Whenever one of the hydra's heads is severed, the hydra loses 1 of its extra reactions per round.

items.name: 吞星多头蛇之头
items.description:
HP（头部）22，头部重生

免疫区域伤害

弱点挥砍10
items.expectedDescription:
HP (head) 22, head regrowth

Immunities area damage

Weaknesses slashing 10

items.name: 呕吐陨石
items.description: 布朗科猛甩全身，以@Template[cone|distance:30]喷吐陨石碎块，对区域内所有生物造成@Damage[5d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic|options:area-effect]）。区域变为困难地形，持续1分钟，不过生物可以用一个交互动作清理一格碎石。布朗科在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Vomit Meteorites]]{1d4轮}内不能呕吐陨石。
items.expectedDescription: Bronco lurches its entire body, spewing forth chunks of meteorite in a @Template[cone|distance:30] that deal @Damage[5d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in the area (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic|options:area-effect]). The area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute, though a creature can use an Interact action to clear one square of the rubble. Bronco can't Vomit Meteorites for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Vomit Meteorites]]{1d4 rounds}.

items.name: 晕眩术
items.description:
你侵入目标的心智，以精神冲击使其晕眩。这道冲击造成1d6心灵伤害，目标进行基础意志豁免。如果目标豁免大失败，它还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}。

升阶（+2）伤害增加1d6。
items.expectedDescription:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

items.name: 诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你从群星之间的黑暗虚空中凝聚一束侵袭心灵的诡异能量，射向目标。对抗目标的AC进行远程法术攻击检定。命中时，你造成2d6心灵伤害。大成功时，你造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 伤口回响
items.expectedDescription:
You manifest an injury from the future or past to harm a creature in the present. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. The target takes 1d8 of the selected damage type with a basic Will save. If the target fails its save and then takes the same type of damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an additional @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage on a failure increases by 1d4.
items.description:
你自未来或者过去具现出一道伤口来伤害当下的生物。选择钝击，穿刺或挥砍伤害，目标受到1d8所选类型伤害，具有一次基础意志豁免。如果目标豁免失败，并且在你的下个回合结束前受到了相同类型的伤害，其还会额外受到@Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]]伤害。

升阶（+2）初始伤害增加1d8，豁免失败时的持续伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 传讯术
items.description:
你轻轻动嘴低语，言语却不从嘴中传出，而直接送入目标耳中。其他人不会比你平常动嘴低语时听得更清楚，但目标听起来如同站在你身旁。目标可以用反应简短回复，也可以选择在其下一回合用自由动作回复，但必须能看见你且位于射程内。回复会直接送入你的耳中，如同最初的信息。

升阶（3环）法术射程提高至500尺。
items.expectedDescription:
You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

items.name: 心灵穿刺
items.expectedDescription:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你以大量心灵信息或神祇裁决使一个生物的心智超载。心灵冲击造成2d6心灵伤害。大失败时，目标还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}状态，持续1轮。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加 2d6。

items.name: 安抚术
items.description:
你安抚目标的心智，增强其精神防御并治疗伤口。施放该法术时，目标恢复1d10+4生命值，并在持续时间内获得对抗心灵效果豁免的+2状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.nkk4O5fyzrC0057i]{法术效果：安抚术}

升阶（+1）治疗量增加1d10+4。
items.expectedDescription:
You grace the target's mind, boosting its mental defenses and healing its wounds. The target regains 1d10+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell and gains a +2 status bonus to saves against mental effects for the duration.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.nkk4O5fyzrC0057i]{Spell Effect: Soothe}

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 1d10+4.

items.name: 恐惧术
items.description:
你将恐惧植入目标；它必须进行意志豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}状态。

失败目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}状态。

大失败目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧3}状态，并处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}状态1轮。

升阶（3环）你能以至多五个生物为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

items.name: 简易伪装
items.description: 格拉布齐特融入周围的物体，始终@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}。
items.expectedDescription: A grabzit blends in with objects in their surroundings and is always @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

items.name: 绕过防火墙
items.description:
触发格拉布齐特的故障打击正影响一件科技物体

效果在1轮内，格拉布齐特对持有触发物品的生物进行的打击，额外造成等于该物品故障值的精准伤害。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The grabzit's Glitching Strikes are affecting a tech object

Effect The grabzit's Strikes deal additional precision damage equal to the item's glitching value to the creature holding the triggering item for 1 round.

items.name: 故障打击
items.description: 每当格拉布齐特以打击或法术指定一个生物为目标，目标持有的一件科技物体会@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障1}，重击时则@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{故障2}。
items.expectedDescription: Whenever a grabzit targets a creature with a Strike or spell, a tech object the target is holding becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1} (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 2} on a critical hit).

items.name: 远程骇入
items.description: 格拉布齐特远程骇入30尺内一个生物持有或穿戴的、具有科技特征的物品。该生物尝试@Check[will|dc:20]豁免。失败时，它受到@Damage[1d6[electricity]]伤害，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}1轮。格拉布齐特也可以用此能力骇入具有科技特征的生物。
items.expectedDescription: The grabzit remotely hacks an item with the tech trait held or worn by a creature within 30 feet. The creature attempts a @Check[will|dc:20] save. On a failure, it takes @Damage[1d6[electricity]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. A grabzit can also use this ability to Hack creatures with the tech trait.

items.name: 虫群心智
items.description: （灵光） 30尺。所有处于彼此范围内的虫群心智盟友能够进行持续的心灵沟通，并且彼此知道对方察觉到的所有威胁。如果此生物处于至少一个具有虫群心智的盟友的范围内，则其在对抗心灵效果的豁免上掷骰出成功时，改为获得大成功。
items.expectedDescription: 30 feet. All allies with colony mind within the listed range of each other are in constant telepathic communication and are aware of all threats any individual knows about. While within range of at least one ally with colony mind, when a creature rolls a success on a save against a mental effect, it gets a critical success instead.

items.name: 烟雾敏感
