items.expectedDescription: The false apari must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:16] save each round it's in the presence of smoke or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

items.name: 觅食巢群
items.description: 伪聚生巢群分散组成个体，扫描大片区域来搜寻，尝试寻找30尺内未探明或躲藏的生物。
items.expectedDescription: The false apari Seeks by dispersing constituents to scan a wide area, attempting to find undetected or hidden creatures within 30 feet.

items.name: 掠飞连击
items.description: 布兰图沿直线飞行至多等于其速度的距离，并对直线上至多三个生物各进行一次翼刺打击。打击命中时，该生物受到伤害，并措手不及，直到布兰图的下一回合开始。
items.expectedDescription: The braantu flies up to its Speed in a line and makes a wing spur Strike against up to three creatures in the line. If the Strike hits, the creature takes damage and is off-guard until the beginning of the braantu's next turn.

items.name: 振动视觉
items.description: 收割者的扫描器使其善于精确定位目标。它无视@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。
items.expectedDescription: The Harvest's scanners make it excellent at pinpointing targets. It ignores the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition.

items.name: 音乐短曲
items.description: 收割者无论走到哪里都会播放欢快的音乐。@Template[type:emanation|distance:60]内所有生物对抗收割者的察觉检定获得+1环境加值。收割者可以用一个单动作关闭音乐，使其隐秘获得+4环境加值。
items.expectedDescription: The Harvest plays cheerful music wherever it goes. All creatures within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60] gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks against the Harvest. The Harvest can turn the music off as a single action; this gives it a +4 circumstance bonus to Stealth.

items.name: 天花板坠袭
items.description:
需求收割者位于天花板或墙壁上

效果收割者尖叫着扑向下方生物，进行跳跃。着地时位于其空间内的任何生物都必须通过@Check[reflex|dc:26]豁免，否则受到@Damage[5d6[bludgeoning]]伤害。豁免大失败的生物被击至@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The Harvest is on a ceiling or wall

Effect The Harvest shrieks and drops onto creatures below it. It Leaps. Any creature within its space when it lands must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:26] save or take @Damage[5d6[bludgeoning]] damage. Creatures that critically fail their save are knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

items.name: 追逐程序
items.description: 收割者行走两次，随后打击一个生物。打击成功时，目标的惊惧状态值增加1。
items.expectedDescription: The Harvest Strides twice and Strikes at a creature. On a successful Strike, the target increases its frightened condition by 1.

items.name: 收割有机物
items.description:
需求一个死亡生物位于收割者的触及范围内

效果收割者以惊人的精确度将血肉从骨骼上剥离，融入自身。它获得等于该生物等级两倍的临时生命值，持续1分钟；此效果可以累积，每次使用都会重置持续时间，同一时间至多给予收割者30点临时生命值。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The Harvest is within reach of a dead creature

Effect The Harvest strips flesh from bone with startling precision, fusing it into its body. The Harvest gains temporary Hit Points equal to double the creature's level for 1 minute; this effect is cumulative, resetting the duration each time the ability is used, and can give the Harvest up to a maximum of 30 temporary Hit Points at a time.

items.name: 畸形尖叫
items.description: 收割者发出吃力的尖啸，听来既像故障机器人，又像腐烂气管发出的声音。120尺内所有生物都必须通过@Check[will|dc:26]豁免，否则@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}1分钟，大失败时则@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧3}。随后，这些生物免疫畸形尖叫24小时。
items.expectedDescription: The Harvest lets out a strained shriek that is equal parts malfunctioning robot and decaying windpipes. All creatures within 120 feet must make a @Check[will|dc:26] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} for 1 minute (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} on a critical failure). Creatures are then immune to Malformed Scream for 24 hours.

items.name: 月侧清洁工
items.description: 收割者始终将清洁指令放在首位。看见有人弄乱环境时，它必须通过@Check[will|dc:23]豁免，否则花费一个动作清洁。
items.expectedDescription: The Harvest's command to clean is always its first priority. When it sees a mess being created, it must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:23] save or spend an action cleaning.

items.name: 可重构骨架
items.description: 收割者可以如同小型生物一般挤过空间。
items.expectedDescription: The Harvest can Squeeze through spaces as if it were a Small creature.

items.name: 怪异怒火
items.expectedDescription:
You channel the bizarre powers that exist beyond the outer reaches of the universe, dealing 3d12 mental damage to each creature in the area as phantasmal claws, jaws, and tentacles lash out at each target. Each creature in the area must attempt a Will save. The area is difficult terrain for any creature sickened by the effects of this spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.
items.description:
你引导存在于宇宙之外，不可名状的力量，对区域内所有生物造成3d12心灵伤害，如同幻影尖爪、啃咬或是触须击中每个目标。区域中的每个生物都需要尝试一次意志豁免。区域对每个因该法术效果陷入恶心的生物都视为困难地形。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害。

失败该生物受到全部伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}。

大失败该生物受到两倍伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d12。

items.name: 岁月重担
items.expectedDescription:
You burden a creature's body and mind with the pains and sorrows of a lifetime. The target takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage and 3d8 mental damage and must attempt a Will saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is encumbered for 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The mental damage increases by 2d8.
items.description:
你将目标毕生的苦痛与哀伤化作沉重枷锁，压垮目标的身心。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰。目标受到3d8钝击伤害和3d8心灵，并且必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标受到一半伤害。

失败目标受到全伤害并且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]1轮。

大失败目标受到全伤害并且超载1分钟。

升阶（+1）心灵伤害增加2d8

items.name: 熵击
items.expectedDescription:
You unleash a ray of entropy that rapidly and indiscriminately decays matter. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 5d8 void damage, or it takes 2d6 persistent acid damage and is glitching 1 if it has the tech trait. On a critical hit, double the damage, and if the creature has the tech trait, it's glitching 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1 die.
items.description:
你释放一束熵射线，迅速且无差别地分解物质。对抗目标的AC进行远程法术攻击。命中时，目标受到5d8虚能伤害；如果目标具有科技特征，则改为受到2d6持续强酸伤害，并陷入故障1。重击时，伤害翻倍；如果该生物具有科技特征，还会陷入故障2和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}。

升阶 （+1）增加1个伤害骰。

items.name: 虚空低语
items.expectedDescription:
The target hears ominous sounds containing unspeakable mysteries from beyond the stars that disorient its mind. The target attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The target hears the strange whispers, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target begins to wander aimlessly, using each action to Step in a random direction. When it moves, the target takes the safest route and doesn't enter hazardous terrain. The spell has a duration of 1 minute or until a creature uses a hostile action against the target.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target babbles incoherently. Any creature that begins its turn within 20 feet of the target must attempt a Will saving throw. On a failure, it must use its first action on its next turn to Step in a random direction and becomes immune to this spell for 24 hours. This is an incapacitation effect.
items.description:
目标耳边响起蕴含星辰之外不可名状奥秘的不祥之音，使其神智混乱。目标需要尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功目标听到了诡异的低语，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}，持续1轮。

失败目标开始漫无目的地游荡，使用每个动作来快步（方向随机）。当其移动时，其会采取最安全的路线并且不会进入有害地形。法术会持续1分钟或者直到目标被敌对动作瞄准。

大失败类似失败，除了目标还会语无伦次地喋喋不休。任何在其20尺内开始回合的生物也需要尝试一次意志豁免。在失败时，这些生物也需要在下回合开始时花费第一个动作来进行快步（随机方向），随后临时免疫此法术24小时。这是一个失能效果。

items.name: 侦测思想
items.expectedDescription:
You sense the presence of thinking creatures around you. You detect the presence or absence of thoughts from conscious creatures that have Intelligence modifiers of –3 or higher. You can choose to ignore the thoughts of creatures you're familiar with so they don't interfere with your detection of other thoughts. The spell can penetrate some barriers, but 3 feet of dirt or wood, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or any force barrier blocks it. Creatures who are immune to mental effects are immune to detection by this spell.

Heightened (4th) You detect the number of thinking minds and whether or not the creatures are telepathic. Creatures with telepathy have louder thoughts than creatures who don't have telepathy and might be able to sense your intrusion, at the GM's discretion.
items.description:
你能感知周围生物的想法。你可以侦测周围是否存在智力调整值不低于-3的清醒生物的思维。可选择忽略熟悉生物的思维，避免干扰其他目标的侦测。该法术可以穿透一些障碍，但3尺的泥土或木头、1尺的石头、1英寸的金属、薄薄的铅片或任何立场障碍都会阻挡它。对心灵效果免疫的生物对该法术的侦测免疫。

升阶（4环）你侦测到具有思维的心智数量，并知晓这些生物是否具有心灵感应。具有心灵感应的生物，其思维比不具备心灵感应者更响亮，也可能察觉你的侵入，具体由GM决定。

items.name: 末日刷屏
items.expectedDescription:
You magically broadcast grim news onto nearby devices, holo projectors, screens, and other displays (including comm units on armor). Creatures in the area who can see one or more displays must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the display.

Failure The creature is fascinated by the display and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (even if the fascination ends).

Critical Failure The creature is fascinated by the display, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} (even if the fascination ends).
items.description:
你可以用魔法在附近的设备、全息投影仪、屏幕和其他显示器（包括护甲上的通讯单元）上播报可怕的消息。区域内能看到一个或多个显示屏的生物必须尝试意志豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物因显示内容@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]。

失败该生物被显示内容迷魂，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}状态（即使迷魂结束也是如此）。

大失败该生物被显示内容迷魂，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧3}状态，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{毁灭1}状态（即使迷魂结束也是如此）。

items.name: 时间子弹
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger You fail (but not critically fail) an attack roll with a weapon.

You rewind time and adjust probability to ensure an attack that just missed still does damage to its intended target. Roll damage as though you hit the target with the Strike, but the target only takes half the damage. You are then immune to temporal bullets for 10 minutes.
items.description:
触发你用武器的攻击检定失败（但非大失败）。

你可以倒退时间并调整概率，以确保刚刚失误的攻击仍能对目标造成伤害。你进行一次伤害骰，就像你用打击命中了目标，但目标只受到一半的伤害。你之后会临时免疫时间子弹10分钟。

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你从群星之间的黑暗虚空中凝聚一束侵袭心灵的诡异能量，射向目标。对抗目标的AC进行远程法术攻击检定。命中时，你造成2d6心灵伤害。大成功时，你造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 伤口回响
items.expectedDescription:
You manifest an injury from the future or past to harm a creature in the present. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. The target takes 1d8 of the selected damage type with a basic Will save. If the target fails its save and then takes the same type of damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an additional @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage on a failure increases by 1d4.
items.description:
你自未来或者过去具现出一道伤口来伤害当下的生物。选择钝击，穿刺或挥砍伤害，目标受到1d8所选类型伤害，具有一次基础意志豁免。如果目标豁免失败，并且在你的下个回合结束前受到了相同类型的伤害，其还会额外受到@Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]]伤害。

升阶（+2）初始伤害增加1d8，豁免失败时的持续伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 摄像视觉
items.description: 月亮小姐能通过月侧250号上的每一台摄像机观察，如同@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{鹰眼术}。
items.expectedDescription: Missy Moon can see through every camera on Moonside-250, as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{Clairvoyance}.

items.name: 数字支配
items.description: 月亮小姐能骇入月侧250号上的任何计算机，如同使用控制机器法术。同一时间，她只能控制一台计算机。被月亮小姐控制的计算机可以使生物暴露于月侧监视者作祟。
items.expectedDescription: Missy Moon can hack into any computer on Moonside-250 as if using the control machine spell. Missy Moon can control only one computer at a time. Computers controlled by Missy Moon can expose creatures to the Moonside Watcher haunt.

items.name: 闪烁消隐
items.description: 月亮小姐像熄灭的霓虹灯一样暗下，隐形直到其下一回合开始。
items.expectedDescription: Missy Moon dims like an extinguished neon light, becoming invisible until the beginning of her next turn.

items.name: 我即月侧
items.description: 月亮小姐专注于自己与月侧250号本为一体，使自身的各部分从地板、墙壁和天花板上显现。在[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}内，月亮小姐可以用120尺触及范围尝试幽灵之触打击，或从120尺内任意位置施法。
items.expectedDescription: Missy Moon focuses on how she and Moonside-250 are one, allowing parts of herself to manifest from the floor, the walls, and the ceiling. For [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}, Missy Moon can attempt ghostly touch Strikes with a reach of 120 feet or cast spells from any point within 120 feet.

items.name: 突现惊吓
items.description:
需求月亮小姐的回合开始，且她此前处于隐形状态

效果月亮小姐重新现身，在一个活物面前尖叫。她行走至多等于其速度的距离，并尝试对一个与其相邻的生物[[/act demoralize]]。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements Missy Moon's turn begins, and she was invisible

Effect Missy Moon reappears, screaming in the face of a living creature. She Strides up to her Speed and attempts to [[/act demoralize]] a creature she is adjacent to.

items.name: 吞食辐射
items.description: 暴露于轻度辐射时，辐射爬行者获得快速治疗2。在严重辐射中，该能力增至快速治疗5；在极度辐射中变为再生10；在严酷辐射中，辐射爬行者还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}。
items.expectedDescription: While exposed to mild radiation, a radiation crawler gains fast healing 2. In severe radiation, this increases to fast healing 5; in extreme radiation, it becomes regeneration 10; and in incredible radiation, the radiation crawler is additionally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}.

items.name: 辐射中毒
items.description: 如果辐射爬行者的核能猛击打击重击一个生物，该生物必须通过@Check[fortitude|dc:19]豁免，否则受到3环辐照术的效果。在辐射更高的区域，该法术升阶至与当地辐射程度相符的环级。
items.expectedDescription: If a radiation crawler critically strikes a creature with its nuclear slam Strike, the creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:19] save or be subject to the effects of a 3rd-rank irradiate spell. In areas of higher radiation, the spell heightens to match the level of local radiation.

items.name: 突发洪水
items.description:
触发引导智能激活该危害

效果滚烫的水对所有生物造成@Damage[1d10[fire]]伤害。危害随后投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The Guiding Intelligence activates the hazard

Effect Scalding water deals @Damage[1d10[fire]] damage to all creatures. The hazard then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The rivers and streams bubble and boil over, flooding the streets of the town with scalding water.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 河流和溪流沸腾漫溢，滚烫的水淹没镇上的街道。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[athletics|dc:22] (trained) to Climb or Swim to safety, or @Check[athletics|dc:25] (trained) to pull a creature to safety
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[athletics|dc:22]（受训）以攀爬或游泳至安全地点；或@Check[athletics|dc:25]（受训）以将一个生物拉到安全地点

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) A wave of scalding, 20-foot-deep water surges through town, dealing @Damage[(2d8+9)[fire]] damage to all creatures in the water (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save). Creatures in the water must hold their breath or begin drowning.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）一波深20尺的滚烫水浪涌过城镇，对水中所有生物造成@Damage[(2d8+9)[fire]]伤害，目标进行@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic]豁免。水中生物必须屏息，否则开始溺水。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The trap deactivates and resets after 3 rounds.

7TRt5gMQR2CNofyF.name: 故障饮料机 Malfunctioning Beverage Machine

items.name: 供给饮料
items.description:
触发一个生物向机器输入错误指令

效果机器喷出滚烫液体，造成@Damage[(1d6+10)[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害，影响@Template[type:cone|distance:15]内的所有生物，目标进行@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic]豁免。机器随后投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature inputs the wrong commands into the machine

Effect The machine expels scalding hot liquid that deals @Damage[(1d6+10)[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures within a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] save). It then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A beverage machine begins shuddering before spewing scalding liquid onto bystanders.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一台饮料机开始颤抖，随后向旁观者喷出滚烫液体。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[crafting|dc:17] or @Check[computers|dc:17] to disable the machine or @Check[athletics|dc:15] to push it over on its side
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[crafting|dc:17]或@Check[computers|dc:17]以解除机器；或@Check[athletics|dc:15]以将其推倒。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The beverage machine continues spewing liquid in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15]. It then attempts a cup throw Strike at the nearest target.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）饮料机继续向@Template[type:cone|distance:15]喷出液体，随后对最近目标尝试一次投掷杯子打击。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The beverage machine runs out of liquid after 4 rounds, and cups after 6 rounds.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 饮料机在4轮后耗尽液体，在6轮后耗尽杯子。

8mrbCW1egVL4Jg40.name: 噬电兽核能木乃伊 Electrovore Nuclear Mummy

items.name: 崩解形体
items.description: 核能木乃伊受到严重电离，已濒临崩解。一旦其生命值降至最大生命值的一半以下，或受到重击伤害，就开始分崩离析，AC降至15。
items.expectedDescription: A nuclear mummy is ionized to the point of disintegration. Once a nuclear mummy is reduced to fewer than half its Hit Points, or upon being damaged by a critical hit, it starts falling apart, reducing its Armor Class to 15.

extraFields.expected: Crumbling Form Damaged by Critical Hit
extraFields.text: 崩解形体：受到重击伤害

items.name: 电离存在
items.description: 10尺。核能木乃伊具有很强的放射性。在弥漫内开始自己回合的任何活物受到@Damage[1d6[poison]]伤害，并进行@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic]豁免。
items.expectedDescription: 10 feet. The nuclear mummy is highly radioactive. Any living creature that starts its turn within the emanation takes @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic] save).

items.name: 能量汲取
items.description: 噬电兽木乃伊以尾部打击重击持用或穿戴科技装备的活物，或具有科技特征的生物时，会抽取目标的一部分电能。噬电兽立即恢复@Damage[5[healing]]生命值，且在接下来的10分钟内每分钟额外恢复1点生命值；多次抽取不会增加这部分额外治疗。
items.expectedDescription: When an electrovore mummy scores a critical hit with a tail Strike against a living creature wielding or wearing tech gear or a creature with the tech trait, it siphons off a portion of the target's electrical energy. This restores @Damage[5[healing]] Hit Points to the electrovore immediately, plus 1 Hit Point per minute for the next 10 minutes; the additional healing doesn't increase if the electrovore siphons multiple times.

items.name: 亵邪辐射
items.description:
核能木乃伊的触碰带有致突变的辐射。感染的生物在治愈疾病前，无法恢复亵邪辐射造成的伤害

豁免检定@Check[fortitude|dc:20]

阶段1携带疾病，无不良效果（1日）

阶段2@Damage[1d6[poison]]伤害（1日）

阶段3@Damage[1d6[poison]]伤害（1日）

阶段4@Damage[1d6[poison]]伤害（1日）

阶段5死亡，并作为核能僵尸复起，使用漂流尸归返者的数据
items.expectedDescription:
The nuclear mummy's touch carries a mutating radiation. An infected creature can't heal damage it takes from unholy radiation until it has been cured of the disease

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:20]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage (1 day)

Stage 3 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage (1 day)

Stage 4 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage (1 day)

Stage 5 dead, rising as a nuclear zombie (using a driftdead returned's statistics)

items.name: 电震
items.description:
触发一个生物直接或用工具抓住活板门

效果陷阱对触发生物及其5尺内的生物造成@Damage[5d8[electricity]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic]豁免）。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature grasps the trapdoor directly or with a tool

Effect The trap deals @Damage[5d8[electricity]] damage to the triggering creature and creatures within 5 feet of the triggering creature (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save).

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A shock grid built into the trapdoor releases a powerful electric charge.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 活板门内置的电击网释放强大电荷。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:16] (trained) to disable the trapdoor's programming, @Check[crafting|dc:17] (trained) to rewire the shock grid, or @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to deactivate the shock grid
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:16]（受训）以停用活板门程序；@Check[crafting|dc:17]（受训）以重新连接电击网线路；或@Check[thievery|dc:18]（受训）以停用电击网

items.name: 深坠
items.description:
触发一个生物踏上龟裂地面

效果该生物踩碎薄薄的地壳，坠落其中。只要与边缘相邻，它就可以使用[[/act grab-an-edge]]反应避免坠落；否则受到坠落伤害，通常从50尺高处坠落会受到@Damage[25[bludgeoning]]伤害。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature steps onto the cracked earth

Effect The creature fractures the thin crust of earth and falls through. That creature can use the [[/act grab-an-edge]] reaction to avoid falling, as long as it's adjacent to an edge. Otherwise, it takes falling damage (typically @Damage[25[bludgeoning]] damage for a 50-foot drop).

cnText_system_details_description.expected: This 20-foot square of ground is cobwebbed with cracks and fissures and crumbles when a creature steps on it.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 这片20尺见方的地面布满蛛网般的裂痕，生物踏上时便会崩塌。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[survival|dc:16] to collapse safely, or @Check[crafting|dc:20] (trained) to shore up the area enough to pass over without collapsing it
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[survival|dc:16]以使地面安全塌落；或@Check[crafting|dc:20]（受训）以充分支撑区域，使人能够通过而不致坍塌

items.name: 禁止通行
items.description:
触发一个生物尝试穿过屏障或触碰它

效果屏障将该生物推离，对触发生物进行一次屏障打击。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature attempts to pass through the barrier or touches it

Effect The barrier shunts the creature away, making a barrier Strike against the triggering creature.

items.name: 屏障
items.description: 外加目标被向后推5尺，重击时为10尺。如果触发生物以快步进入屏障，或因强迫移动效果而移动，屏障的命中检定受到–2环境减值。
items.expectedDescription: plus the target is pushed back 5 feet (10 feet on a critical hit). The barrier takes a –2 circumstance penalty to hit if the triggering creature Stepped into the barrier or was moved by a forced movement effect.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A hardlight barrier forms an unnatural cube of glowing blue static that surrounds a computer console.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一道硬光屏障在计算机控制台周围，形成一个发出蓝色杂讯光芒的不自然立方体。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[thievery|dc:23] (trained) to disable the barrier, @Check[computers|dc:24] (trained) to Hack the barrier, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (4th rank; counteract DC 21) to counteract the barrier
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[thievery|dc:23]（受训）以解除屏障；@Check[computers|dc:24]（受训）以骇入屏障；或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}（4环；反制DC 21）以反制屏障

items.name: 电击震慑
items.description:
触发一个生物触碰电线，或解除电线的检定大失败

效果电线造成@Damage[(4d10+26)[electricity]]伤害，影响触发生物及其5尺内的生物，目标进行@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic]豁免。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature touches the wiring or critically fails a check to disable it

Effect The wiring deals @Damage[(4d10+26)[electricity]] damage to the triggering creature and creatures within 5 feet (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save).

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Exposed wires and circuitry nestle like coiled snakes among moving gears and pistons.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 裸露电线与电路如盘蛇般，蜷缩在移动的齿轮和活塞之间。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[athletics|dc:33] (trained), @Check[crafting|dc:27] (expert), or @Check[thievery|dc:29] (expert) to disable this part of the assembler
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[athletics|dc:33]（受训）、@Check[crafting|dc:27]（专家）或@Check[thievery|dc:29]（专家），以解除组装机的这一部分

F2umEZocwH3eet6N.name: 轨道炮炮塔 Rail Gun Turret

items.name: 开火
items.description:
触发一个生物在炮塔60尺内移动

效果炮塔对该生物进行一次轨道炮打击。陷阱随后投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature moves within 60 feet of the turret

Effect The turret makes a rail gun Strike against the creature. The trap then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A mechanized turret pops up on intruders when they enter into range.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 入侵者进入射程时，一座机械炮塔会突然弹出。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:30] (trained) to reprogram the turret, or @Check[crafting|dc:23] (trained) to jam the sensor
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:30]（受训）以重编炮塔；或@Check[crafting|dc:23]（受训）以干扰传感器

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (3 actions) The trap makes a rail gun Strike against up to three creatures in range, or multiple Strikes against one creature in range if it has no additional targets.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （3个动作）陷阱对射程内至多三个生物各进行一次轨道炮打击；如果没有其他目标，则对射程内的一个生物进行多次打击。

items.name: 热量感知
items.description: 通风管毒蛇无法以视觉观察，但能以精确感官侦测散发高于60度热量的生物。生物护甲的环境防护启用时，会阻断通风管毒蛇对穿戴者的感知。
items.expectedDescription: The vent viper can't see via vision but can detect creatures that emit heat warmer than 60 degrees as a precise sense. When environmental protections are active on a creature's armor, they block the vent viper's ability to sense the wearer.

items.name: 通风管毒蛇毒液
items.description:
豁免检定@Check[fortitude|dc:17]

最长持续时间4轮

阶段1@Damage[1d6[poison]]伤害，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}（1轮）

阶段2@Damage[1d6[poison]]伤害，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}
items.expectedDescription:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:17]

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}

cnText_system_perception_details.text: 热量感知（精确）60尺，无视觉

items.name: 系于其主
items.description:
人造人无法说话，但与创造者之间有心灵感应链接。双方可以互通信息，包括主人的知识，以及人造人听到的一切。这条链接的范围为1500尺。人造人的态度通常与创造者相近，并且绝对忠诚。

如果人造人被摧毁，主人受到@Damage[2d10[mental]]伤害。如果主人被杀，人造人会变得无心智，将当前位置作为巢穴，本能地攻击所有接近者。
items.expectedDescription:
A homunculus can't speak, but it is telepathically linked to its creator. It can share information back and forth, including its master's knowledge and everything the homunculus hears. The range of this link is 1,500 feet. The homunculus typically has a similar attitude to its creator and is utterly faithful.

If the homunculus is destroyed, the master takes @Damage[2d10[mental]] damage. If the master is slain, the homunculus becomes mindless, claims its current location as its lair, and instinctively attacks anyone who comes near.

items.name: 人造人毒液
items.description:
人造人头部的储槽内存有一剂毒药。它可以用一个交互动作从储备中补充这剂毒药

豁免 @Check[fortitude|dc:15]

最长持续时间 6轮

阶段1@Damage[1d6[poison]]并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭1}（1轮）。
items.expectedDescription:
A homunculus has one dose of poison in a reservoir in its head. It can refill this poison from its reserves with an Interact action

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:15]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round).

IcTl5hSPXijp0MWc.name: 月侧监视者 The Moonside Watcher

items.name: 恐惧读心
items.description:
触发一个生物在月侧250号上激活带有屏幕的装置

效果一道仅有一只发光白眼的轮廓在杂讯中成形，探入触发生物的心智。目标必须尝试@Check[will|dc:26]豁免。无论结果如何，它都会涌现一个侵入性的念头：“永远留在这里。”

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物感到有眼睛盯着自己，诡异的凝视仿佛钻入血肉，令其惊慌。它受到@Damage[(1d8+2)[mental]]伤害，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}。

失败该生物感觉自己最深处的自我被看穿。向该生物提出一个问题；生物首次对抗此作祟失败时，问题是：“你经历过最糟糕的事情是什么？”后续问题围绕此主题展开，例如“当时你多大？”“那是你应得的吗？”或“你会梦到它吗？”该生物必须诚实回答，但无需说出声。它受到@Damage[(2d8+4)[mental]]伤害，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}。

大失败该生物凝视杂讯中的影像，感觉自我意识逐渐消失。它会被问三个问题，受到@Damage[(4d8+8)[mental]]伤害，惊惧2并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}3轮，且暴露于监视者的凝视诅咒。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature activates a device with a screen aboard Moonside-250

Effect A silhouette with a single, glowing white eye takes shape in the static and probes the triggering creature's mind. The target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] save. Regardless of the result, the creature experiences an intrusive thought: "Stay here forever."

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature feels eyes watching them and panics as the eerie gaze seems to bore into their flesh. The creature takes @Damage[(1d8+2)[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature feels their deepest self being perceived. Ask the creature a question; the first time a creature fails against this haunt, the question is "What is the worst thing to ever happen to you?" Future questions build off this topic, such as "How old were you?", "Did you deserve it?", or "Do you dream of it?" The creature must answer honestly but doesn't have to respond out loud. The creature takes @Damage[(2d8+4)[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature feels their sense of self fading as they gaze at the image in the static. The creature is asked three questions, takes @Damage[(4d8+8)[mental]] damage, is frightened 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 3 rounds, and is exposed to the Watcher's Stare curse.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The screen erupts into static shaped vaguely like the outline of a person with only half a head.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 屏幕骤然充满杂讯，隐约构成一个只有半颗头的人形轮廓。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[religion|dc:26] or @Check[occultism|dc:26] (to ward off the haunt)
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[religion|dc:26]或@Check[occultism|dc:26]以抵御作祟

items.name: 让雪飘落
items.description:
触发引导智能激活暴风雪模组

效果狂风开始呼啸，积雪向四处飞旋，形成白茫天。暴风雪投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The Guiding Intelligence activates the blizzard module

Effect The wind begins howling and snow swirls in every direction, creating a whiteout. The blizzard rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A deluge of ice, snow, and sleet swirls with the howling wind.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 大量冰、雪和雨夹雪随呼啸狂风飞旋。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[nature|dc:18] or @Check[survival|dc:18] (trained) to find shelter; @Check[crafting|dc:20] (trained) or @Check[Engineering Lore|dc:20] (trained) to create shelter; @Check[acrobatics|dc:22] (trained), @Check[athletics|dc:22] (trained), or @Check[nature|dc:22] (trained) to quickly carry plants and animals inside
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[nature|dc:18]或@Check[survival|dc:18]（受训）以寻找庇护所；@Check[crafting|dc:20]（受训）或@Check[Engineering Lore|dc:20]（受训）以建造庇护所；@Check[acrobatics|dc:22]（受训）、@Check[athletics|dc:22]（受训）或@Check[nature|dc:22]（受训），以迅速将动植物搬入室内

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The blizzard swirls. Creatures trapped in the blizzard are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF], and take @Damage[(2d8+7)[cold]] damage each round (@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic] save).
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）暴风雪盘旋肆虐。被困其中的生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{目盲}、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]，并每轮受到@Damage[(2d8+7)[cold]]伤害，目标进行@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic]豁免。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The blizzard lasts for 10 rounds, then subsides to a snowstorm.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 暴风雪持续10轮，随后减弱为普通雪暴。

items.name: 狂风
items.description:
触发引导智能激活该危害

效果风暴对所有生物和建筑造成@Damage[1d8[bludgeoning]]伤害。风暴投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The Guiding Intelligence activates the hazard

Effect The windstorm deals @Damage[1d8[bludgeoning]] damage to all creatures and structures. The windstorm rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Howling winds tear across the valley, uprooting trees and ripping roofs off buildings.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 呼啸狂风横扫山谷，连根拔起树木，撕去建筑屋顶。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[nature|dc:19] (trained) or Survival (trained) to take shelter, or @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save to endure the Gust
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[nature|dc:19]（受训）或生存（受训）以寻求庇护；或@Check[fortitude|dc:23]豁免以承受狂风

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The windstorm gusts, dealing @Damage[(2d8+9)[bludgeoning]] damage to all creatures and structures in the town.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）风暴掀起狂风，对镇内所有生物和建筑造成@Damage[(2d8+9)[bludgeoning]]伤害。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The windstorm deactivates and resets after 3 rounds.

NcCzuhhR6bE18n2c.name: 化学诱杀陷阱 Chemical Booby-Trap

items.name: 化学反应
items.description:
触发一个生物打开通往区域A13的门

效果胶囊破碎，有毒烟气充满区域。以门为中心的@Template[type:emanation|distance:15]内的所有生物都必须通过@Check[fortitude|dc:18]豁免，否则会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}；弥漫留下的化学云雾具有迷雾术效果，持续3轮。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature opens the door to area A13

Effect The capsules shatter, and noxious fumes fill the area. All creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] centered on the door must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:18] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}; the emanation leaves behind a cloud of chemicals with the effect of mist for 3 rounds.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Chemical vials are rigged to break when someone opens the door.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 化学药瓶被设置为在有人开门时破裂。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) to cut the trip wires around the door without shattering the capsules.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[thievery|dc:18]（受训）以切断门周围的绊线，而不打碎胶囊。

O96L4EmgcoL8ysrc.name: 吞噬者的诱惑 Devourer's Temptation

items.name: 入教仪式
items.description:
触发任何尚未受入教仪式的生物进入礼拜室

效果陷阱对触发生物进行一次吞噬者之口打击，随后投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger Any uninitiated creature enters the worship chamber

Effect The trap makes a Devourer's maw Strike against the triggering creature. The trap then rolls initiative.

items.name: 毁灭真相
items.description:
吞噬者的诱惑呈现出侵入心智的毁灭与末日幻象，试图以吞噬者的力量，以及每个体验者及其所有亲爱之人终将死亡的必然，震慑所有经历此景的生物。礼拜室内所有尚未受入教仪式的生物都必须尝试@Check[will|dc:24]豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响，并能立即用一个反应尝试帮助一个受到影响的生物，见“解除”。

成功该生物不受影响。

失败该生物受到@Damage[(2d8+9)[mental]]伤害，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{迷魂}，直到有生物将其唤回神来。该生物随后免疫毁灭真相24小时。

大失败该生物受到@Damage[(4d8+18)[mental]]伤害，迷魂直到有生物将其唤回神来，且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}24小时。该生物随后免疫毁灭真相24小时。
items.expectedDescription:
The Devourer's temptation manifests an intrusive vision of destruction and doom, attempting to awe all who experience it with the power of the Devourer and the inevitability of death for them and all their loved ones. All uninitiated creatures in the worship chamber must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and can immediately attempt to help an affected creature as a reaction (see Disable).

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(2d8+9)[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} until a creature revives them. The creature is then immune to Devastation's Truth for 24 hours.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[(4d8+18)[mental]] damage, is fascinated until a creature revives them, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 24 hours. The creature is then immune to Devastation's Truth for 24 hours.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: This swirling column of glowing red light is enchanted with the unholy magic of the Devourer. Looking into its depths shows any creature the power of true devastation, filling them with longing and despair.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 这根旋转的红色光柱被吞噬者的亵邪魔法附魔。凝视其深处，任何生物都会看见真正毁灭的力量，心中充满渴望与绝望。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[athletics|dc:19] or @Check[medicine|dc:19] to revive an affected creature, @Check[occultism|dc:22] or @Check[performance|dc:22] to weave your own message into the projection, @Check[arcana|dc:24] or @Check[computers|dc:24] to disrupt the projections, or @Check[religion|dc:25] to invoke your deity for protection
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[athletics|dc:19]或@Check[medicine|dc:19]以使受影响生物回过神来；@Check[occultism|dc:22]或@Check[performance|dc:22]以将自己的讯息编入投影；@Check[arcana|dc:24]或@Check[computers|dc:24]以扰乱投影；或@Check[religion|dc:25]以祈求自己神祇的庇护

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (3 actions) The trap uses Devastation's Truth to try to incapacitate all creatures in the worship chamber, then makes a Devourer's maw Strike against a creature in range that resisted the trap's effects.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （3个动作）陷阱使用毁灭真相，试图使礼拜室内所有生物失去行动能力，随后对射程内一个抵御了陷阱效果的生物进行吞噬者之口打击。

P1qqKvHeBahnY6dd.name: 月亮小姐人体模型 Missy Moon Mannequins

items.name: 苏醒
items.description:
触发一个生物尝试从区域B15拿走任何物品

效果房门锁上，所有人体模型猛地向触发生物移动，行走至多15尺，随后投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature tries to remove any items from area B15

Effect The door to the room locks, and the mannequins all lurch toward the triggering creature, Striding up to 15 feet, then roll initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Three Missy Moon mannequins spring to life, animated by a supernatural force.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 三个月亮小姐人体模型受超自然力量驱动，突然活过来。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[thievery|dc:18] (trained) three times to unlock the doors or @Check[religion|dc:22] (trained) to exorcise a spirit from one mannequin
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[thievery|dc:18]（受训）三次以解锁房门；或@Check[religion|dc:22]（受训）以驱除一个人体模型中的精魂

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (9 actions) Each of the mannequins uses three of the haunt's actions on each turn, and the haunt loses three actions each turn for every disabled or destroyed mannequin. Each mannequin uses its first action to Stride up to 15 feet and spends its remaining two actions making mannequin fist or flung trinket Strikes. Each mannequin has its own separate multiple attack penalty.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （9个动作）每个人体模型每回合使用作祟的三个动作，每有一个人体模型被解除或摧毁，作祟每回合便少三个动作。每个模型用第一个动作行走至多15尺，剩余两个动作用于模型拳击或投掷饰物打击。每个模型分别计算自己的多重攻击减值。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The mannequins freeze in place as soon as there is no life within the room, resetting the haunt.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 房内没有生命后，人体模型立刻僵在原地，作祟重置。

items.name: 狂暴进食
items.description: 机械蝗虫群必须消耗有机物。如果并未与有机物处于同一空间并进食，就必须行走，直到能如此做。
items.expectedDescription: The mechanolocust swarm must consume organic material. If they're not actively sharing space with and eating organic material, they must Stride until they are.

items.name: 休眠模式
items.description: 机械蝗虫可以进入休眠状态，看似死亡，也没有电脉冲。在此状态下，其隐秘调整值为+20。
items.expectedDescription: Mechanolocusts can enter a dormant state, appearing dead and without electrical impulse. When in this state, their Stealth modifier is +20.

items.name: 虫群啮咬
items.description: 集群空间内的每个敌人受到@Damage[(2d10+5)[piercing]]伤害，并进行@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic]豁免。豁免失败的生物还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}，直到集群的下一回合开始。
items.expectedDescription: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes @Damage[(2d10+5)[piercing]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save. A creature that fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} until the start of the swarm's next turn.

items.name: 易燃点火
items.description:
触发一个生物使用具有火特征的攻击或能力

效果易燃气体被点燃，造成@Damage[(4d8+14)[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害，影响以触发生物为中心的@Template[type:burst|distance:20]内的所有生物，目标进行@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic]豁免。如果触发生物豁免失败，还会着火，受到@Damage[1d8[persistent,fire]|options:area-damage]伤害。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature uses an attack or ability with the fire trait

Effect The volatile gases ignite, dealing @Damage[(4d8+14)[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures within a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] centered on the triggering creature (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic] save). If the triggering creature fails its save, it catches on fire and takes @Damage[1d8[persistent,fire]|options:area-damage] damage.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A noxious, volatile gas cloud fills the air.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一团有毒的易燃气体充满空气。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[Physical Science Lore|dc:20] (trained) or @Check[survival|dc:20] (trained) to filter the gas, or gust of wind or a similar spell to dispel the gas
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[Physical Science Lore|dc:20]（受训）或@Check[survival|dc:20]（受训）以过滤气体；或用造风术或类似法术驱散气体

items.name: 陨石雨
items.description:
触发引导智能激活该危害

效果一颗小行星撞上城中一座随机建筑，造成@Damage[1d10[bludgeoning]]伤害。危害随后投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The Guiding Intelligence activates the hazard

Effect An asteroid collides with a random structure in town, dealing @Damage[1d10[bludgeoning]] damage. The hazard then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: An asteroid hurtles toward Moondrop Springs, surrounded by a collection of smaller, flaming projectiles.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一颗小行星冲向月滴温泉，周围环绕着一群更小的燃烧投射物。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[acrobatics|dc:24] (trained) or Piloting (trained) to dodge incoming meteors, or @Check[nature|dc:28] (trained) or @Check[religion|dc:28] (trained) to invoke primal or divine protection from meteoric destruction
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[acrobatics|dc:24]（受训）或驾驶（受训）以躲避飞来的流星；或@Check[nature|dc:28]（受训）或@Check[religion|dc:28]（受训），以祈求原能或神术庇护，免遭流星毁灭

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (3 actions) The trap makes three meteor Strikes against creatures or structures.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （3个动作）陷阱对生物或建筑进行三次陨石打击。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The trap deactivates and resets after 3 rounds.

ZZ4Vz6LU2CIGiRCi.name: 隐蔽矿井 Hidden Mine Shaft

items.name: 陷坑坠落
items.description:
触发一个生物走上活板门

效果触发生物跌入其中并受到坠落伤害，通常为@Damage[30[bludgeoning]]伤害。该生物可以用[[/act grab-an-edge]]反应避免坠落。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature walks onto the trapdoor

Effect The triggering creature falls in and takes falling damage (typically @Damage[30[bludgeoning]] damage). That creature can use the [[/act grab-an-edge]] reaction to avoid falling.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A wooden trapdoor covers a mine shaft that's 10 feet square and 60 feet deep.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一扇木制活板门覆盖着一口10尺见方、60尺深的矿井。

@Check[thievery|dc:21] to remove the trapdoor

Trapdoor Hardness 3; Trapdoor HP 12 (BT 6); Immunities critical hits, object immunities, precision damage
cnText_system_details_disable.text:
@Check[thievery|dc:21]以移除活板门

活板门硬度3；活板门HP12（BT 6）；免疫重击、物体免疫、精准伤害

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: Creatures can still fall into the mine shaft, but the trapdoor must be reset manually for the hazard to become hidden again.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 生物仍可能跌入矿井，但必须手动重置活板门，危害才能再次隐藏。

items.name: 巨蜈蚣毒
items.description:
豁免检定@Check[fortitude|dc:14]

最长持续时间 6轮

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[occultism|dc:30] or @Check[religion|dc:30] to banish the spirits, @Check[athletics|dc:26] to physically shake a creature into consciousness, or @Check[medicine|dc:24] to treat a creature's dissociative symptoms.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[occultism|dc:30]或@Check[religion|dc:30]以驱逐精魂；@Check[athletics|dc:26]以摇晃一个生物，使其恢复意识；或@Check[medicine|dc:24]以治疗生物的解离症状。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected:
(3 actions) If there are fewer than two creatures under the haunt's effect, it selects a new target to replace a missing patient or doctor; the target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] save. On the doctor's turn, they step forward and begin applying medical care to the patient. The doctor attempts a @Check[medicine|dc:25] check. Afterward, they can attempt a new Will save to escape the haunt.

Critical Success The doctor does not harm the patient.

Success The doctor deals @Damage[(1d8+4)[poison]] damage, @Damage[(1d8+4)[piercing]] damage or @Damage[(1d8+4)[slashing]] damage to the target (chosen at random).

Failure As success, but the doctor deals @Damage[(2d8+9)[poison]] damage, @Damage[(2d8+9)[piercing]] damage or @Damage[(2d8+9)[slashing]] damage

Critical Failure As success, but the doctor deals @Damage[(4d8+18)[poison]] damage, @Damage[(4d8+18)[piercing]] damage or @Damage[(4d8+18)[slashing]] damage.
cnText_system_details_routine.text:
（3个动作）如果受作祟影响的生物不足两个，作祟选择一个新目标，替代缺席的病人或医生；目标必须尝试@Check[will|dc:26]豁免。医生的回合中，它走上前开始为病人治疗，尝试@Check[medicine|dc:25]检定。之后，医生可以再次尝试意志豁免，摆脱作祟。

大成功医生不会伤害病人。

成功医生对目标造成@Damage[(1d8+4)[poison]]伤害、@Damage[(1d8+4)[piercing]]伤害或@Damage[(1d8+4)[slashing]]伤害，随机决定。

失败如同成功，但医生造成@Damage[(2d8+9)[poison]]伤害、@Damage[(2d8+9)[piercing]]伤害或@Damage[(2d8+9)[slashing]]伤害

大失败如同成功，但医生造成@Damage[(4d8+18)[poison]]伤害、@Damage[(4d8+18)[piercing]]伤害或@Damage[(4d8+18)[slashing]]伤害。

cnText_system_details_reset.text: 除非病人与医生的悲痛得到化解，否则作祟在1日后重置。

items.name: 溺水空气
items.description:
触发一个生物移入金字塔下方的空间

效果触发生物虽然身处空气中，却感觉肺部灌满了水。它受到@Damage[(2d6+5)[void]]伤害，并进行@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic]豁免。大失败时，目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失1}1日。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature moves into a space underneath the pyramid

Effect The triggering creature feels its lungs fill with water, despite being in air. They take @Damage[(2d6+5)[void]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic] save). On a critical failure, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} for 1 day.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: With each rotation of the pyramid, energy collects in the crater beneath it.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 金字塔每次旋转，都会使下方陨坑积聚能量。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[religion|dc:14] to counteract the daemonic energy or @Check[thievery|dc:17] to stop the pyramid's movement

items.name: 饥饿巨口
items.description:
触发一个生物进入巨口前方的@Template[type:cone|distance:15]区域

效果巨口将影响区域内的一切吸向处理机构，随后投掷先攻。受影响区域内的生物必须尝试@Check[reflex|dc:26]豁免。在巨口内部开始自己回合的生物受到@Damage[(1d10+9)[bludgeoning],(1d10+9)[piercing],(1d10+9)[slashing]|options:area-damage]{1d10+9钝击伤害、1d10+9穿刺伤害及1d10+9挥砍伤害}伤害。在巨口中死亡的生物会与全部装备一同被彻底摧毁。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物被向吸入巨口拖拽5尺。

失败该生物被向巨口拖拽10尺，并被击至@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。

大失败该生物被拖拽20尺并拉入巨口，倒地且受到@Damage[(2d10+9)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]伤害。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature enters the @Template[type:cone|distance:15] area in front of the maw

Effect The maw draws everything within the area of effect toward its processing mechanisms and then rolls initiative. Creatures in the affected area must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:26] save. Any creature that starts its turn within the maw itself takes @Damage[(1d10+9)[bludgeoning],(1d10+9)[piercing],(1d10+9)[slashing]|options:area-damage]{1d10+9 bludgeoning damage, 1d10+9 piercing damage, and 1d10+9 slashing} damage. A creature that dies within the maw is destroyed completely, along with all of their gear.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is dragged 5 feet toward the intake maw.

Failure The creature is dragged 10 feet toward the maw and knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Critical Failure The creature is dragged 20 feet and pulled into the maw, knocked prone, and takes @Damage[(2d10+9)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A rotating 20-foot aperture full of blades, grinders, and mashers attempts to suck anything within a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] area in front of it into its processors.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一个20尺大小、不断旋转的开口充满刀刃、研磨器和捣碎器，试图将前方@Template[type:cone|distance:15]区域内的一切吸入处理机构。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[crafting|dc:24] (expert) to carefully disassemble the maw's parts, @Check[athletics|dc:28] to stop the blades, or @Check[thievery|dc:26] (expert) to trip the mechanisms; two successes are required to disable the intake maw
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[crafting|dc:24]（专家）以小心拆解巨口部件；@Check[athletics|dc:28]以停止刀刃；或@Check[thievery|dc:26]（专家）以卡住机构；解除吸入巨口需要两次成功

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (3 actions) The trap turns its @Template[type:cone|distance:15] 45 degrees.

效果该生物陷入吸陷淤泥，深至膝部，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature steps into any square adjacent to a pond in Calthorn Woods

Effect The creature sinks into the sucking mud up to its knees. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Water fills deep pits in the thick clay that surrounds a forest pond, creating sticky, smelly mud.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 水填满林间池塘周围厚黏土中的深坑，形成黏稠恶臭的淤泥。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[nature|dc:18] or @Check[survival|dc:18] to find a safe path through the mud, or @Check[acrobatics|dc:20] or @Check[athletics|dc:20] to pull yourself or another creature free
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[nature|dc:18]或@Check[survival|dc:18]以找到穿过淤泥的安全路线；或@Check[acrobatics|dc:20]或@Check[athletics|dc:20]以将自己或另一个生物拉出

Trigger Pressure is applied to the floor tiles

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

items.name: 呻吟
items.description:
触发一个生物攻击员工

效果飞螅族呻吟扭动，试图驱退攻击者。30尺内所有非员工生物都必须通过@Check[will|dc:18]豁免，否则只要危害仍在运作，它们就会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}。飞螅族随后投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature attacks an employee

Effect The barathu moans and squirms, attempting to ward off the attackers. All non-employee creatures within 30 feet must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:18] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} for as long as the hazard remains active. The barathu then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The merged barathu twitches and groans, trying to stop others from rescuing them.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 融合的飞螅族抽搐呻吟，试图阻止别人救援自己。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[athletics|dc:17] (trained) to hold the barathu's tentacles down until they give up, @Check[diplomacy|dc:19] (expert) to plead with the barathu to stop; two total successes (using any skills) are required to disable the haunt
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[athletics|dc:17]（受训）以按住飞螅族触手，直到其放弃；@Check[diplomacy|dc:19]（专家）以恳求飞螅族停下；解除作祟总计需要两次成功，可使用任意技能

The barathu doesn't apply a multiple attack penalty to the second attempt to Grab.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （3个动作）飞螅族尝试攫抓10尺内至多两个生物，运动调整值为+14，随后挤压每个因其而@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}的生物，造成@Damage[(1d10+4)[bludgeoning]]伤害。第二次攫抓尝试不受多重攻击减值影响。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The hazard resets automatically after a few moments out of combat, healing only if fed.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 离开战斗片刻后，危害自动重置，只有被喂食时才会恢复生命。

cnText_prototypeToken_name.expected: Delightful Agony in Nourishing the Meek

items.name: 非人之声
items.description: 电子幻影的下颚向下延伸至胸口，发出可怕的尖叫。20尺内的所有生物都必须通过@Check[will|dc:20]豁免，否则@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}。受到幻影“至深噩梦”能力影响的生物，其豁免受到–2环境减值。
items.expectedDescription: The electronic figment's jaw stretches downward to its chest, letting out a terrible scream. All creatures within 20 feet must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:20] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. Creatures affected by the figment's worst nightmare ability take a –2 circumstance penalty to their save.

items.name: 至深噩梦
items.description: 电子幻影能改变外貌，模仿曾在战斗或创伤记忆中伤害目标的生物。打击一个生物后，幻影会变成该生物最深的噩梦；对抗该目标生物时，其AC和豁免获得+2环境加值。
items.expectedDescription: The electronic figment can alter its appearance to resemble creatures that have previously hurt the target, whether in combat or traumatic memories. After Striking a creature, the figment's appearance changes to the creature's worst nightmare; it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and saves against its target creature.

items.name: 腐化地形
items.description:
触发一个生物进入作祟控制的区域

效果作祟在腐化地形表上掷骰，随后投掷先攻。所有效果的DC均为20。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature enters the area the haunt has power over

Effect The haunt rolls on the Corrupt Terrain table, then rolls initiative. The DC for all effects is 20.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A supernatural power rapidly changes the surroundings of this area to horrify the living.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一种超自然力量迅速改变此处环境，恐吓活物。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: Disable @Check[perception|dc:26] to see through the haunt or @Check[occultism|dc:30] or @Check[religion|dc:30] to banish the visions, and @Check[diplomacy|dc:28] to snap someone else out of it once you are free. Disabling only ends the haunt's effects on one creature.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: 解除：@Check[perception|dc:26]以看穿作祟；或@Check[occultism|dc:30]或@Check[religion|dc:30]以驱逐幻象；自身脱离后，还可以用@Check[diplomacy|dc:28]使另一个生物清醒过来。解除只会结束作祟对一个生物的影响。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected:
(3 actions) The haunt rolls on the Corrupt Terrain table.

[[/r 1d6]]

Results

1

Flesh and egg-sacs crawl along the walls, and an acidic smell penetrates your nose. Living creatures must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save, becoming sickened 1 on a failure and sickened 2 on a critical failure. This lasts until the haunt ends. (visual)

2

The walls morph into sharp iron spikes splattered with blood, and meat hooks dangle from the ceiling. Living creatures moving in the area take 4d8 piercing damage (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic] ). (metal)

3

Infinite darkness envelops you, and the sounds of something tremendously huge rumble nearby. The haunt casts a 2nd-rank darkness spell.

4

Plants made of flesh, bones, and nerves grow from all surfaces, crying out in the voices of agonized loved ones. Living creatures must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20] save or become frightened 1 until the haunt ends (frightened 2 on a critical failure). (auditory, emotion, mental, fear)

5

Everything goes white, and you feel your senses leaving you as your body goes numb. Living creatures take 4d8 cold damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic] save). (visual)

6

You experience your worst nightmare again (as the electronic figment's ability). Living creatures take 4d8 mental damage (@Check[will|dc:20|basic] save). (emotion, mental)
cnText_system_details_routine.text:
（3个动作）作祟在腐化地形表上掷骰。

[[/r 1d6]]

结果

1

血肉和卵囊沿墙壁蠕动，酸气钻入鼻腔。活物必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:20]豁免，失败时恶心1，大失败时恶心2，持续到作祟结束。（视觉）

2

墙壁变成沾血的尖锐铁刺，天花板垂下肉钩。在区域内移动的活物受到4d8穿刺伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic]）。（金属）

3

无尽黑暗笼罩你，附近传来某种无比庞大之物的轰鸣。作祟施放2环黑暗术。

4

血肉、骨骼和神经构成的植物从所有表面生长，以饱受折磨的亲爱之人的声音哭喊。活物必须通过@Check[will|dc:20]豁免，否则惊惧1，持续到作祟结束，大失败时惊惧2。（听觉、情绪、心灵、恐惧）

5

一切化为白色，身体麻木，感官仿佛逐渐离你而去。活物受到4d8寒冷伤害，并进行@Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic]豁免。（视觉）

6

你再次经历最深的噩梦，如同电子幻影的能力。活物受到4d8心灵伤害，并进行@Check[will|dc:20|basic]豁免。（情绪、心灵）

items.name: 落石
items.description:
触发一个生物踏入区域，或在区域内造成任何扰动，例如发射投射物

效果支撑隧道的支架倒塌，大量土石倾泻而下。区域内所有生物受到@Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]]伤害，并进行@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic]豁免。区域变为高等困难地形。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature steps into the area or causes any sort of disruption within the area (such as firing a projectile)

Effect The supports maintaining the tunnel collapse, bringing a deluge of earth. All creatures in the area take @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:18|basic] save. The area becomes greater difficult terrain.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Years of mining and erosion have made the walls and ceiling of this 20-foot square unstable, causing frequent rockslides.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 多年采矿和侵蚀使这片20尺见方区域的墙壁与天花板变得不稳，频繁发生落石。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[survival|dc:21] (trained) to map a path that doesn't cause any rockfalls, or @Check[crafting|dc:25] (expert) or Engineering Lore (trained) to build a support and maintain the integrity of the tunnel
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[survival|dc:21]（受训）以规划不会引发落石的路线；或@Check[crafting|dc:25]（专家）或工程学识（受训），以搭建支撑，维持隧道完整

items.name: 重力旋转
items.description:
触发一个生物或物体进入地图标示的区域

效果引力子棱镜加快旋转，造成@Damage[1d12[bludgeoning]]伤害。棱镜5尺内的所有生物都必须尝试@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic]豁免。失败时，生物还被向远离引力子棱镜的方向推5尺，大失败时为10尺。引力子棱镜随后投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature or object enters the area marked on the map

Effect The graviton prism increases the velocity of its rotation, dealing @Damage[1d12[bludgeoning]] damage. All creatures within 5 feet of the graviton prism must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save. On a failure, creatures are additionally pushed 5 feet away from the gravitational prism (10 feet on a critical failure). The graviton prism then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The prism rotates rapidly, causing water to spin alongside it.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 棱镜高速旋转，带动水流一起旋转。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[thievery|dc:17] to jam the rotating mechanism, or DC 19 to pull the graviton prism out of rotation
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[thievery|dc:17]以卡住旋转机构；或DC 19以将引力子棱镜拉离旋转

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The graviton prism hums as it continues to increase the rate at which it spins. All creatures within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] of the prism must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic] save. On a failure, a target is pushed back 5 feet (10 feet on a critical failure). Each subsequent time the graviton prism attempts its routine, the emanation increases by 5 feet (maximum of 25 feet).
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）引力子棱镜嗡鸣着不断加快旋转。距棱镜@Template[type:emanation|distance:10]内的所有生物都必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic]豁免。失败时，目标被向后推5尺，大失败时为10尺。此后每次引力子棱镜执行流程，弥漫就增加5尺，最大为25尺。

items.name: 瘴气涌动
items.description:
触发一个当前未遭受苦难或不利状态的活物进入区域I8

效果瘴气试图填满未受苦难者的肺部。所有触发生物受到@Damage[2d12[mental]]伤害，并进行@Check[will|dc:18|basic]豁免，随后作祟投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A living creature that is not currently suffering from an affliction or detrimental condition enters area I8

Effect The miasma attempts to fill the lungs of those who don't suffer. All triggering creatures take @Damage[2d12[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:18|basic] save), then the haunt rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The essence of suffering appears in this room as a miasma that attempts to drown those that have escaped pain.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 苦难的本质在房内显现为瘴气，试图淹没那些逃脱痛苦的生物。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[occultism|dc:15] (trained) or @Check[religion|dc:15] (trained) to soothe the suffering spirits, or @Check[nature|dc:18] to disperse the miasma with a gust of wind.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[occultism|dc:15]（受训）或@Check[religion|dc:15]（受训）以安抚受苦的精魂；或@Check[nature|dc:18]以一阵风驱散瘴气。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The miasma attempts to suffocate all living creatures in area I8 not currently suffering from an affliction or detrimental condition. Targets must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:18] save. On a failure, the target begins suffocating.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）瘴气试图使区域I8内当前未遭受苦难或不利状态的所有活物窒息。目标必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:18]豁免，失败时开始窒息。
